-- Shared spatial playback for authored ability stages and authoritative boss cues.
-- One-shots own their hosts so a short VFX teardown cannot cut off an impact tail.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Bank = require(script.Parent.CombatSoundBank)
local Sounds = require(script.Parent.Sounds)
local Audio = {ids = {}, Bank = Bank}
local byId, active, recent = {}, {}, {}
local voices, preloaded = 0, false
for key, definition in pairs(Bank) do
	Audio.ids[key] = definition.id
	byId[definition.id] = definition
end

local function positionOf(target)
	if typeof(target) == "Vector3" then return target end
	if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
	if target:IsA("Attachment") then return target.WorldPosition end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.Position end
	if target:IsA("Model") then return target:GetPivot().Position end
	local part = target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	return part and part.Position
end

function Audio.play(key, target, volume, pitch, looped, options)
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return nil end
	local definition = Bank[key] or byId[key]
	local id = definition and definition.id or key
	if type(id) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local position = positionOf(target)
	if not position then return nil end
	options = options or {}
	local range = options.range or 230
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera and (camera.CFrame.Position-position).Magnitude > range then return nil end
	local now = os.clock()
	local bucket = id .. ":" .. math.floor(position.X/16) .. ":" .. math.floor(position.Y/16) .. ":" .. math.floor(position.Z/16)
	if now-(recent[bucket] or -math.huge) < (options.throttle or .055) or voices >= 40 then return nil end
	recent[bucket] = now
	for name, at in pairs(recent) do if now-at > 3 then recent[name] = nil end end
	local attached = looped and typeof(target)=="Instance" and (target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Attachment"))
	local host
	if not attached then
		host = Instance.new("Part")
		host.Name = "CombatSoundAnchor"
		host.Anchored, host.CanCollide, host.CanTouch, host.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
		host.Transparency, host.Size, host.Position = 1, Vector3.one, position
		host.Parent = workspace
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name, sound.SoundId = key, id
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(pitch or 1, .3, 2.5)
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance, sound.RollOffMaxDistance = options.near or 12, range
	sound.Looped = looped == true
	local base = math.min(volume or .45, 1) * (definition and definition.gain or 1)
	sound.Volume = Sounds.volume(base)
	sound:SetAttribute("CombatAudio", true)
	sound.Parent = if attached then target else host
	active[sound] = base
	voices += 1
	local cleaned = false
	local function cleanup()
		if cleaned then return end
		cleaned = true
		active[sound] = nil
		voices -= 1
		if host then host:Destroy() end
	end
	sound.Destroying:Once(cleanup)
	sound.Ended:Once(function() sound:Destroy() end)
	local clip = options.clip or (definition and definition.clip)
	if clip then
		task.delay(math.max(0, clip/sound.PlaybackSpeed-.1), function()
			if sound.Parent then TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(.1), {Volume=0}):Play() end
		end)
	end
	local lifetime = if looped then (options.lifetime or 15)
		else ((clip or (definition and definition.duration) or 7)/sound.PlaybackSpeed + .15)
	Debris:AddItem(sound, math.min(lifetime, 30))
	sound:Play()
	return sound
end

function Audio.preload()
	if preloaded or not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	preloaded = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local batch = {}
		for _, definition in pairs(Bank) do
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound"); sound.SoundId = definition.id
			table.insert(batch, sound)
			if #batch == 8 then
				pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(batch) end)
				for _, item in ipairs(batch) do item:Destroy() end
				batch = {}; task.wait()
			end
		end
		pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(batch) end)
		for _, item in ipairs(batch) do item:Destroy() end
	end)
end

function Audio.stats()
	return {voices=voices}
end

-- Persistent choreography can animate a loop without bypassing the SFX slider.
function Audio.setVolume(sound, volume)
	if not sound or active[sound] == nil or not sound.Parent then return end
	local definition = byId[sound.SoundId]
	local base = math.clamp(volume, 0, 1) * (definition and definition.gain or 1)
	active[sound] = base
	sound.Volume = Sounds.volume(base)
end

-- Existing SFX settings apply to sounds already ringing out as well as new plays.
if RunService:IsClient() then
	task.defer(function()
		local settings = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.UI.PlayerSettings)
		settings.Changed.Event:Connect(function(key)
			if key ~= "sfxVolume" then return end
			for sound, base in pairs(active) do
				if sound.Parent then sound.Volume = Sounds.volume(base) end
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return Audio

local function play(layers, position, scope)
	for _, layer in ipairs(layers or {}) do
		local sound = Audio.play(layer[1], position, layer[2], layer[3])
		if scope and sound then scope:add(sound) end
	end
end
function Cues.cast(payload, scope)
	local profile = references[payload.ability]
	if profile and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(payload.startedAt or 0)<.65 then
		play(profile.cast, payload.origin.Position, scope)
		if payload.ability == "Fireball" then
			local age = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-payload.startedAt
			if age < .22 then
				scope:delay(.22-age,function() play(profile.release,payload.origin.Position) end)
			end
		end
	end

function Cues.packet(packet)
	local profile = references[packet.ability]
	if not profile or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(packet.startedAt or 0)>.65 then return end
	play(profile[packet.event or "hit"], packet.position)
end

	local layers = profile and profile[payload.kind]
	if not layers or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(payload.startedAt or 0)>.65 then return end
	if payload.boss=="Signus" and payload.kind=="crescentBreak" and payload.struck then
		layers={{"glass_break1",.4,.9}}
	end
	local p = payload.position
	local bucket = payload.boss..":"..payload.kind..":"..math.floor(p.X/24)..":"..math.floor(p.Z/24)
	local now = os.clock()
	local gap = if payload.kind=="furrow" or payload.kind=="beamImpact" or payload.kind=="rainImpact" then .2 else .08
	if now-(recent[bucket] or -math.huge)<gap then return end
	recent[bucket] = now
	for key, at in pairs(recent) do if now-at>4 then recent[key]=nil end end
	play(layers, p)

-- Audio-only cues use the existing boss presentation remote and broadcast radius.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Remote = Remotes.ensure("BossEffect", "RemoteEvent")
local BossAudio = {}
function BossAudio.emit(boss, kind, position)
	local payload = {boss=boss, kind=kind, position=position, audioOnly=true, startedAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()}
	for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and (root.Position-position).Magnitude <= 420 then Remote:FireClient(player, payload) end
	end

local CombatAudio = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.CombatAudio)
-- Abyss Gate, built from complete pack assemblies round its ground sigil:
--   call     Impact #48 flares at the caster's hand
--   sigil    two rings, a turning band of runes and a pentagram draw
--            themselves on the ground at the aim, showing the gate's reach,
--            while the Portals rift opens flat over them and drinks in light
--   erupt    Impact #44 and #48 blast out and Alternate #29's beams tear up
--            into a dark column, with impact frames, a shake and a punch
--   implode  the column is sucked back down and Impact #37 and #44 burst on
--            the server's collapse hit
-- The sigil is textured Beams; Parts are invisible emitter hosts only.
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.AbyssPlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Library = require(script.Parent.AbyssParticles)
local Pack = require(script.Parent.PackAssembly)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local VOID = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local INK = Color3.fromRGB(30, 16, 52)
local DUSK = Color3.fromRGB(125, 95, 210)
local PALE = Color3.fromRGB(236, 230, 255)
local VIOLET = Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 255)
local TINT = {deep = INK, main = VIOLET, hot = PALE}
local ns, curve = Kit.ns, Kit.curve
local live = 0
local preloaded = false

local Sheets = {
	-- Slash VFX Trail2: a soft-edged band, laid flat for the sigil's strokes.
	Band = {Texture = "rbxassetid://16892374733"},
}

local SOUND_CALL = CombatAudio.ids.magic_warp
local SOUND_BOOM = CombatAudio.ids.boom_deep2
local SOUND_HIT = CombatAudio.ids.synth_blast

function VFX.preload()
	Pack.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload({Library.PillarCore.Texture, Sheets.Band.Texture}, {SOUND_CALL, SOUND_BOOM, SOUND_HIT})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

-- A stroke lying flat in its host's XZ plane: the host stands with Y along
-- the ground normal. Flat particles do not show on this ground, so the whole
-- sigil is drawn in beams: crisp bands for the ink, the pillar's soft streak
-- for glows.
local function stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
	local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
		Texture = texture or if emission > 0 then Library.PillarCore.Texture else Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
		Segments = 12, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
		Brightness = if emission > 0 then 2 else 1, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false, ZOffset = z or 0,
	})
	return {beam = beam, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, width = width}
end

local function tangent(theta)
	return Vector3.new(-math.sin(theta), 0, math.cos(theta))
end

local function radial(theta)
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
end

-- A beam bends along its attachments' X axes and spreads its width along
-- their Y axes, so a stroke lies flat when Y points across it on the ground.
-- A cubic arc is circular when its control points sit (4/3)tan(sweep/4) of
-- the radius along each end's tangent.
local function layoutArc(s, radius, t0, t1, opacity, widthScale)
	s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t0) * radius, tangent(t0), radial(t0))
	s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t1) * radius, tangent(t1), radial(t1))
	local k = 4 / 3 * math.tan((t1 - t0) / 4) * radius
	s.beam.CurveSize0, s.beam.CurveSize1 = k, k
	local width = s.width * (widthScale or 1)
	s.beam.Width0, s.beam.Width1 = width, width
	Kit.opacity(s.beam, opacity)
end

local function layoutLine(s, from, to, opacity)
	local along = to - from
	if along.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		Kit.opacity(s.beam, 0)
		return
	end
	local across = Vector3.yAxis:Cross(along).Unit
	s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(from, along.Unit, across)
	s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(to, along.Unit, across)
	Kit.opacity(s.beam, opacity)
end

-- A whole circle in four quarter arcs.
local function circle(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local arcs = {}
	for q = 1, 4 do arcs[q] = stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture) end
	return arcs
end

local function layoutCircle(arcs, radius, opacity, widthScale)
	for q, s in ipairs(arcs) do
		layoutArc(s, radius, (q - 1) * math.pi / 2, q * math.pi / 2, opacity, widthScale)
	end
end

local function outward(t)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.centre) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3"
		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" or type(payload.seed) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = Plan.duration()
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local origin, centre, normal = payload.origin, payload.centre, payload.normal
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
		local openAt, collapseAt = T.Open, Plan.collapseAt()
	local R = T.Radius
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "AbyssGate"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- The call -----------------------------------------------------------------
	local caster = payload.caster
	local character = caster and caster.Character
	local hand = character and (character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
	local handPoint = if hand then hand.Position else (origin * CFrame.new(1.2, 0.8, -1)).Position
	local callHost = Kit.host(folder, "Call", CFrame.new(handPoint))
	local callAt = Kit.attachment(callHost, CFrame.new(handPoint))
	local function mount(name, cframe, scale, budget)
		return Pack.mount(scope, folder, name, {cframe = cframe, scale = scale, budget = budget, tint = TINT, brightness = 2})
	end
	-- A dead caster's gate does no more damage on the server, so it closes here.
	Pack.endWithCaster(scope, caster)

	-- The sigil ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local side = normal:Cross(Vector3.zAxis)
	side = if side.Magnitude > 0.1 then side.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
	local ringFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(centre + normal * 0.2, side, normal)
	local outerHost = Kit.host(folder, "Outer", ringFrame)
	local runeHost = Kit.host(folder, "Runes", ringFrame)
	local innerHost = Kit.host(folder, "Inner", ringFrame)
	-- A soft black disc under everything: the pit the gate opens into.
	local shade = circle(outerHost, R, VOID, 0, -0.1, "")
	local outer = circle(outerHost, 1, VOID, 0, 0.1)
	local outerGlow = circle(outerHost, 3.5, DUSK, 1)
	local inner = circle(innerHost, 0.7, VOID, 0, 0.1)
	local innerGlow = circle(innerHost, 2.6, DUSK, 1)
	local runes = {}
	for i = 1, 12 do runes[i] = stroke(runeHost, 0.9, VOID, 0, 0.1) end
	local star, starGlow = {}, {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		star[i] = stroke(innerHost, 0.55, VOID, 0, 0.1)
		starGlow[i] = stroke(innerHost, 2.2, DUSK, 1)
	end
	local starRadius = R * 0.72
	local function vertex(k)
		local t = -math.pi / 2 + k * 2 * math.pi / 5
		return Vector3.new(math.cos(t), 0, math.sin(t)) * starRadius
	end
	local tipGlow = mount("Impact37", ringFrame, 0.2, 30)

	-- The rift hangs over the sigil, its flat layers turned to whoever watches.
	local rift = Pack.mount(scope, folder, "PortalRift", {cframe = CFrame.new(centre + normal * R * 0.6), scale = 0.6, budget = 160, brightness = 3,
		billboard = true, tint = {deep = VOID, main = VIOLET, hot = PALE}})
	rift:stream(true)

	-- The column: Alternate #29's beams run along X, stood up the gate.
	local pillarHost = Kit.host(folder, "Pillar", CFrame.new(centre))
	local column = Pack.mount(scope, folder, "Column29", {cframe = CFrame.fromMatrix(centre + up * T.PillarHeight * 0.5, up, side, up:Cross(side)),
		scale = 1.2, faceCamera = true, tint = TINT, brightness = 2})
	local light = Kit.light(pillarHost, PALE, 45)
	local burstFrame = CFrame.new(centre + up * 2)

	local waveHost = Kit.host(folder, "Wave", ringFrame)
	local eruptWave = circle(waveHost, 2.6, VOID, 0, 0.1)
	local eruptGlow = circle(waveHost, 6, DUSK, 1)
	local implodeWave = circle(waveHost, 1.8, PALE, 1, 0.2)
	local implodeShadow = circle(waveHost, 4, VOID, 0, 0.1)

	local spin = 0
	local last
	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local dt = if last then math.max(elapsed - last, 0) else 0
		last = elapsed
		local erupting = elapsed >= openAt and elapsed < collapseAt
		-- The sigil opens out and lets go after the implosion.
		local open = Kit.smooth(elapsed / 0.3)
		local fade = 1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, collapseAt + 0.05, collapseAt + 0.6)
		local shown = open * fade
		local reach = R * (0.5 + 0.5 * open) * (1 - 0.25 * (1 - fade))
		local glow = (if erupting then 0.9 else 0.55) * shown
		layoutCircle(shade, reach * 0.5, shown * 0.45, 0.98 * reach / R)
		layoutCircle(outer, reach, shown)
		layoutCircle(outerGlow, reach, glow)
		layoutCircle(inner, reach * 0.72, shown)
		layoutCircle(innerGlow, reach * 0.72, glow * 0.8)
		for i, s in ipairs(runes) do
			local t = (i - 1) * math.pi / 6
			layoutArc(s, reach * 0.86, t, t + math.rad(16), shown)
		end
		spin += dt * (if erupting then 2.4 else 0.7)
		innerHost.CFrame = ringFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, spin, 0)
		runeHost.CFrame = ringFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -spin * 0.6, 0)
		-- The pentagram draws itself in one continuous stroke.
		local drawing = false
		local tipAt = Vector3.zero
		local scale = reach / R
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local p = Kit.ramp(elapsed, 0.25 + (i - 1) * 0.1, 0.25 + i * 0.1)
			local from = vertex(2 * (i - 1)) * scale
			local reached = from:Lerp(vertex(2 * i) * scale, p)
			layoutLine(star[i], from, reached, if p > 0 then shown else 0)
			layoutLine(starGlow[i], from, reached, if p > 0 then glow else 0)
			if p > 0 and p < 1 then
				drawing = true
				tipAt = reached + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0)
			end
		end
		tipGlow:stream(drawing)
		if drawing then tipGlow:place(innerHost.CFrame * CFrame.new(tipAt)) end
		-- The rift swells as the sigil opens, and goes when the gate implodes.
		rift:rescale(math.round((0.6 + 1.9 * Kit.smooth(elapsed / openAt)) * 8) / 8)
		-- The column shoots up and is sucked back down.
		local rise = Kit.smooth((elapsed - openAt) / 0.12)
		local sink = Kit.ramp(elapsed, collapseAt - 0.14, collapseAt)
		local height = T.PillarHeight * rise * (1 - 0.8 * sink * sink)
		column:beamsOn(erupting and height > 0.5)
		if erupting then
			column:stretch(centre, centre + up * math.max(height, 0.5))
		end
		local after = elapsed - collapseAt
		light.Brightness = if erupting then 1.5 * (1 - sink) elseif after >= 0 then 5 * math.exp(-after * 6) else 0
		-- Ground rings: black out of the eruption, white out of the implosion.
		local w1 = (elapsed - openAt) / 0.5
		local w1On = w1 >= 0 and w1 <= 1
		local r1 = R * (0.6 + 1.8 * outward(w1))
		layoutCircle(eruptWave, r1, if w1On then 1 - w1 else 0, 1 - 0.6 * math.clamp(w1, 0, 1))
		layoutCircle(eruptGlow, r1, if w1On then 0.5 * (1 - w1) else 0)
		local w2 = after / 0.55
		local w2On = w2 >= 0 and w2 <= 1
		local r2 = R * (0.3 + 2.6 * outward(w2))
		layoutCircle(implodeWave, r2, if w2On then 1 - w2 else 0, 1 - 0.5 * math.clamp(w2, 0, 1))
		layoutCircle(implodeShadow, r2 * 0.92, if w2On then 0.8 * (1 - w2) else 0)
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		mount("Impact48", CFrame.new(handPoint), 0.5):burst(0.7)
		Kit.sound(callHost, SOUND_CALL, 0.45, 0.55)
		ImpactFX.shake(origin.Position, 0.3, 0.2, 40)
	end)
	timeline.at(openAt, function()
		mount("Impact44", burstFrame, 2.2):burst(1)
		mount("Impact48", burstFrame, 2.4):burst(1)
		column:stream(true)
		Kit.sound(pillarHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.65, 0.7)
		ImpactFX.hit(centre + up * 3, {tint = PALE, pattern = "double", shake = 1.8, shakeDuration = 0.5, punch = 6, radius = 90})
		ImpactFX.shake(centre, 0.5, T.Erupt, 80)
	end)
	timeline.at(collapseAt, function()
		rift:clear()
		column:clear()
		mount("Impact37", burstFrame, 3):burst(1)
		mount("Impact44", burstFrame, 2.8):burst(1)
		Kit.sound(pillarHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.7, 1.1)
		Kit.sound(pillarHost, SOUND_HIT, 0.5, 0.7)
		ImpactFX.hit(centre + up * 3, {tint = PALE, pattern = "triple", shake = 2.6, shakeDuration = 0.7, punch = 10, radius = 100})
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

-- Dawnbreaker, drawn from one message:

local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.DawnbreakerPlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Library = require(script.Parent.DawnbreakerParticles)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60)
local SUN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 228, 130)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 251, 235)
local AMBER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 32)
local SKY = Color3.fromRGB(130, 225, 255)
local ns, curve, colors = Kit.ns, Kit.curve, Kit.colors
local live = 0
local preloaded = false

-- VFX :D flipbook sheets the curated library does not carry.
local Sheets = {
	-- VFX :D.77: rising light rays. Black background, so fully additive.
	Rays = {
		Texture = "rbxassetid://97915247852729",
		FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,
		FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot,

}

function VFX.preload()

	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload(Kit.textures(Library, Sheets), {SOUND_SWING, SOUND_BURST})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)
	return Kit.emitter(if Sheets[kind] then Sheets else Library, kind, parent, props)
end

-- The crescent's frame at `reach`: middle on the line, flat side up.
local function crescentFrame(from, direction, reach)
	local position = from + direction * reach
	local up = if math.abs(direction.Y) > 0.95 then Vector3.zAxis else Vector3.yAxis
	return CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction, up)
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.finish) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3"
		or type(payload.distance) ~= "number" or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local distance = math.clamp(payload.distance, 0, T.Range)
	local hitAt = Plan.hitAt(distance)
	local total = hitAt + T.Aftermath
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 4 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local from = payload.origin.Position
	local direction = payload.origin.LookVector
	local finish, normal = payload.finish, payload.normal
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "Dawnbreaker"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- Swing ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local swingFrame = crescentFrame(from, direction, 0)
	local swingHost = Kit.host(folder, "Swing", swingFrame)
	-- Top up: VelocityPerpendicular flipbooks lie flat, in the swing's plane.
	local swingFlat = Kit.attachment(swingHost, swingFrame)
	local swingLayers = {
		{emitter("Crescent", swingFlat, {Size = ns(9), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 2, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.26)}), 5},
		{emitter("CrescentFlash", swingFlat, {Size = ns(9), Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), LightEmission = 0.8, Brightness = 2, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}), 2},
		{emitter("SlashAlpha", swingFlat, {Size = curve({0, 7}, {1, 10}), Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD), LightEmission = 0.6, Brightness = 2, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}), 2},
		{emitter("Glints", swingFlat, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Brightness = 3, Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 50)}), 10},
		{emitter("Specs", swingFlat, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), LightEmission = 1, Brightness = 3}), 8},
	}

	-- Flight -------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- The crescent stands across its flight, an arch facing whoever threw it:
	-- one curved beam per layer from tip to tip, both control points lifted
	-- (and led forward) so the crown peaks over the line. The host is the
	-- arch's middle; emitters on the part itself spread across its width.
	local width, arch, bow = T.Width, T.Arch, T.Bow
	local body = Kit.host(folder, "Crescent", crescentFrame(from, direction, 0), Vector3.new(width * 0.8, arch * 0.6, 0.6))
	local tipL = Kit.attachment(body)
	local tipR = Kit.attachment(body)
	local crown = Kit.attachment(body)
	-- A cubic's middle lands 3/4 of the way to its control points.
	local lift = Vector3.new(0, arch / 0.75, -bow / 0.75)
	local liftAxis, liftSize = lift.Unit, lift.Magnitude
	local liftUp = liftAxis:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
	local function layer(kind, color, beamWidth, brightness, zOffset)
		return Kit.beam(body, tipL, tipR, {
			Texture = Library[kind].Texture,
			TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch,
			TextureLength = 1,
			FaceCamera = true,
			Segments = 40,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(color),
			Width0 = beamWidth,
			Width1 = beamWidth,
			CurveSize0 = liftSize,
			CurveSize1 = -liftSize,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Brightness = brightness,
			ZOffset = zOffset,
			Enabled = false,
		})
	end
	local arcs = {
		layer("ArcGlow", AMBER, 12, 1.5, 0),
		layer("ArcBody", GOLD, 7.5, 2, 0.1),
		layer("ArcCore", WHITE, 3.6, 2.5, 0.2),
	}
	-- Two ribbons, tip to crown to tip, leave the arch's afterimage.
	local function afterimage(a0, a1)
		return Kit.trail(body, a0, a1, {
			Texture = Library.Trail.Texture,
			TextureMode = Library.Trail.TextureMode,
			TextureLength = Library.Trail.TextureLength,
			Color = colors(SUN, GOLD, AMBER),
			Transparency = curve({0, 0.3}, {0.5, 0.65}, {1, 1}),
			WidthScale = curve({0, 1}, {1, 0.4}),
			Lifetime = 0.16,
			LightEmission = 1,
			Brightness = 2.5,
			FaceCamera = false,
			Enabled = false,
		})
	end
	local trails = {afterimage(tipL, crown), afterimage(crown, tipR)}
	local streaming = {
		emitter("SlashLines", body, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Rate = 45, Brightness = 1.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 80)}),
		emitter("Sparks", body, {Color = colors(WHITE, GOLD), Rate = 70, Brightness = 2, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)}),
		emitter("FrontFlame", body, {Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD), Rate = 26, Brightness = 1.4, Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 6})}),
		emitter("Glints", body, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Rate = 22, Brightness = 2.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 30)}),
		emitter("Embers", body, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Rate = 30, Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 10), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 0.5}, {1, 0})}),
	}
	local flightLight = Kit.light(body, GOLD, 18)

	-- Burst --------------------------------------------------------------------
	local burstFrame = CFrame.lookAt(finish, finish + normal)
	local burstHost = Kit.host(folder, "Burst", burstFrame)
	local core = Kit.attachment(burstHost, burstFrame)
	-- Front along the surface normal: flat rings lie on the surface.
	local surface = Kit.attachment(burstHost, burstFrame)
	local burst = {
		{emitter("HitGlow", core, {Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 12}, {1, 16}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 1.2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3)}), 1},
		{emitter("GoldLight", core, {Size = curve({0, 10}, {1, 26}), Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD), Brightness = 1, Transparency = curve({0, 0.3}, {1, 1})}), 2},
		{emitter("GoldRing", core, {Size = curve({0, 2}, {0.45, 20}, {1, 26}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.55), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 2, Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("GoldRingWide", core, {Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.35, 12}, {1, 30}), Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD), Brightness = 1.5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5)}), 1},
		{emitter("HitRing", core, {Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.5, 11}, {1, 15}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SKY), Brightness = 2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4)}), 2},
		{emitter("HitStar", core, {Size = curve({0, 10, 2}, {1, 3, 1}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 1.5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.12, 0.3)}), 4},
		{emitter("GoldStar", core, {Size = curve({0, 9, 2}, {1, 3}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.5)}), 6},
		{emitter("Stars", core, {Size = curve({0, 3, 1}, {1, 3, 1}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 2, Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 26), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 4, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1.1)}), 8},
		{emitter("GoldSparks", core, {Color = colors(SUN, GOLD), Speed = NumberRange.new(55, 95), Size = curve({0, 1.6, 0.6}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 2, Drag = 4, LockedToPart = false}), 40},
		{emitter("GoldCubes", core, {Color = colors(SUN, AMBER), Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 70), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 1.3, 0.5}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 1.5, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -50, 0), LockedToPart = false}), 30},
		{emitter("Shards", core, {Color = colors(SUN, AMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 5, 1.5}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 1.2, LightEmission = 1, LockedToPart = false}), 20},
		{emitter("Embers", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 40), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 0.7}, {1, 0}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9), LockedToPart = false}), 30},
		{emitter("Rays", core, {Size = curve({0, 10}, {1, 16}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45), FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(32), Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD), Brightness = 1.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Transparency = curve({0, 0.1}, {0.7, 0.3}, {1, 1}), ZOffset = -1}), 1},
		{emitter("Smoke", core, {Color = colors(AMBER, Color3.fromRGB(90, 50, 25)), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 6, 1}, {1, 8, 1}), Transparency = curve({0, 0.35}, {0.5, 0.75}, {1, 1}), Speed = NumberRange.new(12, 40), Brightness = 1, LightEmission = 0, LockedToPart = false}), 16},
		{emitter("Shockwave", surface, {Size = curve({0, 2}, {0.5, 22}, {1, 30}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5), Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("BlastWind", surface, {Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 18, 1}, {1, 26, 2}), Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Brightness = 1, LightEmission = 1, Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.2, 0.6}, {1, 1}), SpreadAngle = Vector2.zero}), 4},
		{emitter("WindRing", surface, {Size = curve({0, 2}, {0.5, 12}, {1, 16}), Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Brightness = 1.5, Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.1, 0.4}, {1, 1}), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front}), 3},
	}
	local burstLight = Kit.light(burstHost, GOLD, 45)
	local lingering = {
		emitter("Embers", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Rate = 22, Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 9), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0),
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 0.45}, {1, 0}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), LockedToPart = false}),
		emitter("GoldSpecs", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SUN), Rate = 12, Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 10), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9), Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 0.6})}),
	}

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local reach = Plan.reach(elapsed, distance)
		local flying = elapsed >= T.Windup and elapsed < hitAt
		if flying then
			-- Unfolds from half size over its first few studs.
			local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * Kit.smooth((elapsed - T.Windup) / 0.07)
			local half, low = width * 0.5 * s, -arch * 0.5 * s
			tipL.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(-half, low, bow * s), liftAxis, liftUp)
			tipR.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(half, low, bow * s), liftAxis, liftUp)
			crown.Position = Vector3.new(0, arch * 0.5 * s, 0)
			for _, arc in ipairs(arcs) do
				arc.CurveSize0, arc.CurveSize1 = liftSize * s, -liftSize * s
			end
			body.CFrame = crescentFrame(from, direction, reach)
		end
		for _, arc in ipairs(arcs) do
			if arc.Enabled ~= flying then arc.Enabled = flying end
		end
		for _, trail in ipairs(trails) do trail.Enabled = flying end
		Kit.setEnabled(streaming, flying)
		flightLight.Brightness = if flying then 2.2 else 0
		local age = elapsed - hitAt
		burstLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then math.exp(-age * 5) * 4 else 0
		Kit.setEnabled(lingering, age >= 0.15 and age < T.Aftermath - 0.6)
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.burst(swingLayers)
		Kit.sound(swingHost, SOUND_SWING, 0.45, 1.35)
		ImpactFX.shake(from, 0.35, 0.22, 40)
	end)
	timeline.at(hitAt, function()
		Kit.burst(burst)
		Kit.sound(burstHost, SOUND_BURST, 0.6, 1.15)
		ImpactFX.hit(finish, {tint = GOLD, pattern = "triple", shake = 1.9, shakeDuration = 0.55, punch = 7, radius = 80})
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.from) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.landing) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3"
		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = Plan.surgeAt(#T.SurgeRings) + T.Aftermath
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 4 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local from, landing, normal = payload.from, payload.landing, payload.normal
	local hitAt = Plan.hitAt()
	local random = Random.new(payload.seed or 11)
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "Deluge"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- Orb ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- One host for the gather and the flight: a sphere-shaped part, so the
	-- gathering water starts on its surface and closes in.
	local orb = Kit.host(folder, "Orb", CFrame.new(from), Vector3.one * 9)
	local core = Kit.attachment(orb)
	local swirl = emitter("Swirl", core, {
		Size = ns(2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.45), Rate = 22, Speed = NumberRange.new(0),
		Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-200, 200), Color = colors(SEA, DEEP),
		Brightness = 0.7, FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(40), LockedToPart = true, ZOffset = 0.5,
	})
	local blob = emitter("LiquidColor", core, {
		Size = ns(2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.4), Rate = 12, Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
		Color = colors(SEA, DEEP), LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 1, LockedToPart = true,
	})
	local inflow = emitter("Spray", orb, {
		Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere, ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward,
		ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface, Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 22), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.22, 0.3),
		Acceleration = Vector3.zero, Size = curve({0, 1.4, 0.3}, {1, 0}), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM),
		Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.3, 0.2}, {1, 0.6}), LightEmission = 0.5, LightInfluence = 0, Rate = 60, LockedToPart = true,
	})
	local pops = emitter("BubblePop", orb, {
		Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere, ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface,
		Size = ns(1.4), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Rate = 12, LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = true,
	})
	local spray = emitter("Spray", core, {
		EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35), Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 12),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0), Size = curve({0, 1.2, 0.3}, {1, 0}), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA),
		Transparency = curve({0, 0.2}, {1, 1}), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.4, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.55), Rate = 70,
	})
	local mist = emitter("SprayMist", core, {
		EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0),
		Size = curve({0, 1.5}, {1, 3.5, 0.5}), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), LightInfluence = 0, Rate = 14,
	})
	local top = Kit.attachment(orb); top.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	local bottom = Kit.attachment(orb); bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.6, 0)
	local ribbon = Kit.trail(orb, top, bottom, {
		Texture = Library.Trail.Texture, TextureMode = Library.Trail.TextureMode, TextureLength = Library.Trail.TextureLength,
		Color = colors(FOAM, SEA, DEEP), Transparency = curve({0, 0.2}, {1, 1}), WidthScale = curve({0, 1}, {1, 0.3}),
		Lifetime = 0.22, LightEmission = 0.8, Brightness = 1.6, FaceCamera = true, Enabled = false,
	})
	local orbLight = Kit.light(orb, SEA, 16)

	-- Splash ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local splashFrame = CFrame.lookAt(landing, landing + normal)
	local base = Kit.host(folder, "Splash", splashFrame)
	-- Front along the normal: flat rings lie on the ground.
	local flat = Kit.attachment(base, splashFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.15))
	local up = Kit.attachment(base, CFrame.new(landing + normal * 0.5) * CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, normal:Cross(Vector3.zAxis).Magnitude > 0.1 and normal:Cross(Vector3.zAxis).Unit or Vector3.xAxis, normal))
	local high = Kit.attachment(base, CFrame.new(landing + normal * 6))
	local splash = {
		-- The tower: toon water thrown straight up, slowing as it climbs.
		{emitter("LiquidAlpha", up, {Size = curve({0, 6}, {1, 11}), Rotation = NumberRange.new(-25, 25), Color = colors(FOAM, TEAL),
			LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.55, 0.75), Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 30), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(8, 8),
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -22, 0), Drag = 1.5, ZOffset = 1}), 5},
		{emitter("LiquidColor", high, {Size = curve({0, 9}, {1, 15}), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), Color = colors(SEA, DEEP),
			LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.65, 0.8), Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)}), 2},
		{emitter("LiquidAlpha", high, {Size = curve({0, 8}, {1, 13}), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), Color = colors(TEAL, SEA),
			LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.75), Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)}), 2},
		{emitter("PixelBurst", up, {Size = curve({0, 10}, {1, 14}), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0}), 2},
		{emitter("Spray", up, {SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 55), Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 78), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -95, 0),
			Size = curve({0, 2, 0.6}, {1, 0}), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.3,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.8, 0.2}, {1, 1})}), 70},
		{emitter("SprayMist", up, {SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70), Speed = NumberRange.new(16, 34), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0),
			Size = curve({0, 2}, {1, 6, 1}), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3)}), 24},
		{emitter("BubblePop", up, {Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere, Size = ns(2), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), LightInfluence = 0,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(80, 80), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.7)}), 12},
		{emitter("Shockwave", flat, {Size = curve({0, 4}, {0.5, 24}, {1, 30}), Color = ColorSequence.new(TEAL), Brightness = 1.5,
			Transparency = curve({0, 0.1}, {1, 1}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5)}), 1},
		{emitter("GroundRing", flat, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Size = curve({0, 6, 1}, {0.4, 20, 1}, {1, 26, 1})}), 2},
		{emitter("Foam", flat, {Size = curve({0, 8}, {1, 26}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7), FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(22),
			Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("Ripple", flat, {Size = ns(26), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front}), 1},
	}
	local splashLight = Kit.light(base, SEA, 40)
	local lingering = {
		emitter("Mist", high, {Size = curve({0, 6}, {1, 12}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.4), Rate = 7, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.3, 0.6}, {1, 1}),
			LightInfluence = 0.5, Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-20, 20)}),
		emitter("Sparkle", up, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Rate = 14, Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 14), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)}),
		emitter("Spray", up, {SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25), Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 26), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -70, 0),
			Size = curve({0, 1.2, 0.3}, {1, 0}), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, Rate = 30, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.8)}),
	}

	-- Surge ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Geyser spots on each ring, dropped onto whatever ground is under them.
	local params = Kit.rayParams({folder})
	local rings = {}
	for index, radius in ipairs(T.SurgeRings) do
		local count = math.round(radius * 0.75)
		local spin = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
		local spots = {}
		for i = 1, count do
			local angle = spin + (i / count) * math.pi * 2 + random:NextNumber(-0.12, 0.12)
			local around = landing + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * radius
			local hit = workspace:Raycast(around + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), params)
			if hit then
				-- Flipbooks are centred on their emitter, so the splash sits raised.
				table.insert(spots, {
					ground = Kit.attachment(base, CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0))),
					raised = Kit.attachment(base, CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0))),
				})
			end
		end
		local ringFlat = Kit.attachment(base, splashFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.1))
		rings[index] = {
			spots = spots,
			column = emitter("LiquidAlpha", base, {Size = curve({0, 3.5}, {1, 6.5}), Rotation = NumberRange.new(-20, 20), Color = colors(FOAM, TEAL),
				LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.6), Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(6, 6),
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -26, 0), Drag = 1.5}),
			toon = emitter("SplashToon", base, {Size = ns(7), Color = colors(TEAL, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, Rotation = NumberRange.new(-20, 20),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp}),
			jet = emitter("Spray", base, {SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(18, 18), Speed = NumberRange.new(24, 40), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -90, 0),
				Size = curve({0, 1.5, 0.4}, {1, 0}), Color = colors(FOAM, SEA), LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)}),
			foam = emitter("Foam", ringFlat, {Size = curve({0, radius * 1.6}, {1, radius * 2.3}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6),
				FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(24), Color = colors(FOAM, TEAL), LightInfluence = 0, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01),
				Transparency = curve({0, 0.1}, {0.7, 0.3}, {1, 1})}),
		}
	end

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		if elapsed < hitAt then
			local position
			if elapsed < T.Gather then
				position = from
				local k = Kit.smooth(elapsed / T.Gather)
				swirl.Size = ns(2 + 3.5 * k)
				blob.Size = ns(1.5 + 3 * k)
			else
				local t = (elapsed - T.Gather) / T.Flight
				position = Plan.arc(from, landing, t)
				local ahead = Plan.arc(from, landing, math.min(t + 0.05, 1))
				local heading = if (ahead - position).Magnitude > 0.05 then ahead else position + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
				orb.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, heading)
				swirl.Size, blob.Size = ns(5.5), ns(4.5)
			end
			if elapsed < T.Gather then orb.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) end
		end
		local gathering = elapsed < T.Gather
		local flying = elapsed >= T.Gather and elapsed < hitAt
		swirl.Enabled = elapsed < hitAt
		blob.Enabled = elapsed < hitAt
		inflow.Enabled = gathering
		pops.Enabled = gathering
		spray.Enabled = flying
		mist.Enabled = flying
		ribbon.Enabled = flying
		orbLight.Brightness = if elapsed < hitAt then 0.8 + Kit.smooth(elapsed / T.Gather) else 0
		local age = elapsed - hitAt
		splashLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then math.exp(-age * 5) * 3 else 0
		Kit.setEnabled(lingering, age >= 0.1 and age < T.Aftermath - 0.5)
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(orb, SOUND_GATHER, 0.5, 1.35)
	end)
	timeline.at(hitAt, function()
		Kit.burst(splash)
		Kit.sound(base, SOUND_SPLASH, 0.9, 0.9)
		Kit.sound(base, SOUND_BOOM, 0.35, 0.75)
		ImpactFX.hit(landing, {tint = SEA, pattern = "double", shake = 1.7, shakeDuration = 0.5, punch = 6, radius = 75})
	end)
	for index, ring in ipairs(rings) do
		timeline.at(Plan.surgeAt(index), function()
			-- Emit places particles where the emitter is when the frame simulates,
			-- so every geyser has its own copies rather than one moved around.
			for _, spot in ipairs(ring.spots) do
				local column, toon, jet = ring.column:Clone(), ring.toon:Clone(), ring.jet:Clone()
				column.Parent, toon.Parent, jet.Parent = spot.ground, spot.raised, spot.ground
				column:Emit(2)
				toon:Emit(1)
				jet:Emit(5)
			end
			ring.foam:Emit(1)
			Kit.sound(base, SOUND_SPLASH, 0.35, 1.15 + index * 0.1)
			ImpactFX.shake(landing, 0.55, 0.25, 60)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

local CombatAudio = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.CombatAudio)
-- Helios Lance, drawn from one message:
--   charge  a small sun gathers over the caster, embers rushing into it
--   sweep   a lance of molten light pours from it to the ground and drags
--           across, the contact boiling with fire, sparks, rock and smoke,
--           carving a burning scar behind it
--   blast   the beam collapses into a blast at the end of the sweep, with
--           impact frames, a shake and a punch
--   embers  the scar burns on, then smoulders out
-- Every visible effect is an authored particle or textured Beam; Parts are
-- invisible emitter hosts only.
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.HeliosPlan)

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.sun) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.from) ~= "Vector3"
		or typeof(payload.to) ~= "Vector3" or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local blastAt = Plan.blastAt()
	local total = blastAt + T.Aftermath
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local sun, from, to = payload.sun, payload.from, payload.to
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "HeliosLance"

	-- The sun ------------------------------------------------------------------

		Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 3), Brightness = 2, LightEmission = 1})

		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), Transparency = curve({0, 0.4}, {1, 1}), Acceleration = Vector3.zero, LockedToPart = true})
	local ring = emitter("Circle", core, {Color = colors(SUN, EMBER), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera,
		Size = curve({0, 9}, {1, 2}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4), Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Brightness = 2, LightEmission = 1, Rate = 0})
	local inflow = emitter("FireSpecs", sunHost, {Color = colors(SUN, EMBER), Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere,
		ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward, ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface,
		Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 26), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.4), Drag = 0, Size = curve({0, 0.9}, {1, 0}),
		LightEmission = 1, Brightness = 2, Rate = 70})
	local sunLight = Kit.light(sunHost, EMBER, 26)

	-- The lance ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local sunAt = Kit.attachment(sunHost)
	local contact = Kit.host(folder, "Contact", CFrame.new(from))
	local groundAt = Kit.attachment(contact)
	local function lance(kind, color, width, brightness, z, emission)

		return Kit.beam(sunHost, sunAt, groundAt, {

	end
	-- Outside in: a dark magma sheath, the orange flow, a flame core and a
	-- thin sun-white thread.
	local lances = {
		{beam = lance("LavaBeamA", MAGMA, 7.5, 1.4, 0, 0.4), width = 7.5},
		{beam = lance("LavaBeamB", EMBER, 5, 1.6, 0.1, 0.8), width = 5},

		{beam = lance("LavaBeamC", SUN, 1, 2.2, 0.3, 1), width = 1},
	}
	-- What boils up where the lance lands.
	local up = Kit.attachment(contact)
	up.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis)
	local boiling = {
		emitter("Fire", up, {Color = colors(FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.14, 3.4}, {1, 0}), Rate = 70,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 16), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(50, 50), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front,
			Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), LightEmission = 0.6, Brightness = 2}),
		emitter("FireBig", up, {Color = colors(FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.5, 8}, {1, 8.5}), Rate = 14,
			LockedToPart = false, Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, LightEmission = 0.4, Brightness = 2}),
		emitter("Sparks", up, {Color = colors(SUN, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 1.6}, {1, 0}), Rate = 40, Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 80),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, LockedToPart = false, Brightness = 2}),
		emitter("Rock", up, {Color = ColorSequence.new(CHAR), Rate = 14, Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 55), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 1, 0.5}, {1, 0}),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0)}),
		emitter("SmokeDark", up, {Color = colors(SMOKE, CHAR), Size = curve({0, 2}, {1, 7, 1}), Rate = 8, Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Transparency = curve({0, 0.5}, {1, 1}),
			LockedToPart = false, Drag = 1, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)}),
		emitter("Glow", up, {Color = ColorSequence.new(EMBER), Size = curve({0, 7}, {1, 3}), Rate = 14, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.3),
			Brightness = 1.2, LockedToPart = true, Acceleration = Vector3.zero}),
	}
	local contactLight = Kit.light(contact, EMBER, 24)

	-- The scar: laid a segment at a time behind the contact.

		local char = Kit.beam(scarHost, a0, a1, {Texture = Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, FaceCamera = false,

		local hot = Kit.beam(scarHost, a0, a1, {Texture = Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, FaceCamera = false,
			Segments = 2, Width0 = T.ScarWidth * 0.9, Width1 = T.ScarWidth * 0.9, Color = ColorSequence.new(EMBER), LightEmission = 1,
			Brightness = 2, Transparency = ns(0.1), ZOffset = 0.1})
		local mid = (a + b) / 2
		local box = Kit.host(folder, "Burn", CFrame.lookAt(mid + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), mid + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0) + forward),
			Vector3.new(T.ScarWidth, 0.3, math.max((b - a).Magnitude, 0.5)))
		local fire = {
			emitter("FireBig", box, {Color = colors(FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.5, 3.2}, {1, 3.4}), Rate = 3, LockedToPart = false,
				Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0.4, Brightness = 2}),
			emitter("Fire", box, {Color = colors(FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.14, 2.2}, {1, 0}), Rate = 16,
				Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(15, 15),
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0.5, Brightness = 2}),
			emitter("FireSpecs", box, {Color = colors(SUN, EMBER), Rate = 6, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30), Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 1, Brightness = 2,
				Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2)}),
			emitter("SmokeDark", box, {Color = colors(SMOKE, CHAR), Size = curve({0, 1.5}, {1, 5, 1}), Rate = 1.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20), Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
				Transparency = curve({0, 0.6}, {1, 1}), LockedToPart = false, Drag = 0.5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.6)}),
		}
		Kit.setEnabled(fire, true)
		table.insert(segments, {char = char, hot = hot, fire = fire})
	end

	-- The blast ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local blastPoint = Plan.landing(sun, to, params)
	local blastHost = Kit.host(folder, "Blast", CFrame.new(blastPoint))
	local blastCore = Kit.attachment(blastHost)
	local blast = {
		{emitter("Flare", blastCore, {Color = colors(SUN, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 8}, {0.2, 26}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 2}), 1},
		{emitter("Glow", blastCore, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FLAME), Size = curve({0, 20}, {1, 6}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6),
			Brightness = 2, Transparency = curve({0, 0.2}, {1, 1}), Acceleration = Vector3.zero}), 2},
		{emitter("Wind", blastCore, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FLAME), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera,
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 18, 1}, {1, 28, 2}), Brightness = 2, LightEmission = 1}), 3},
		{emitter("Lines", blastCore, {Color = colors(SUN, EMBER), Speed = NumberRange.new(90, 150), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.48, 2.6}, {1, 0})}), 24},
		{emitter("Sparks", blastCore, {Color = colors(SUN, FLAME), Speed = NumberRange.new(60, 120), Size = curve({0, 2.4}, {1, 0}),
			LockedToPart = false, Brightness = 2}), 30},
		{emitter("Rock", blastCore, {Color = ColorSequence.new(CHAR), Speed = NumberRange.new(40, 80), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 1.6, 0.6}, {1, 0}),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}), 24},
		{emitter("FireBig", blastCore, {Color = colors(SUN, FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.4, 9}, {1, 10}), LockedToPart = false,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 14), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Brightness = 2}), 8},
		{emitter("Fire", blastCore, {Color = colors(SUN, FLAME, EMBER), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.14, 3.5}, {1, 0}), Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 40),
			Drag = 4, LightEmission = 0.6, Brightness = 2}), 40},
		{emitter("BlastSmoke", blastCore, {Color = colors(SMOKE, CHAR), Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 60), Size = curve({0, 1}, {0.2, 7, 1}, {0.8, 8, 0.5}, {1, 0}),
			Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.15, 0.55}, {1, 1}), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70)}), 18},
	}
	local blastLight = Kit.light(blastHost, FLAME, 50)

	local lastLanding = nil
	local nextShake = 0
	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local charging = elapsed < T.Charge
		local firing = elapsed >= T.Charge and elapsed < blastAt
		local k = Kit.smooth(elapsed / T.Charge)
		-- The sun swells while it charges and holds while it fires.
		aura.Rate = if charging then 30 + 60 * k elseif firing then 90 else 0
		aura.Enabled = elapsed < blastAt
		glow.Rate = if elapsed < blastAt then 12 else 0
		glow.Enabled = elapsed < blastAt
		glow.Size = curve({0, 4 + 8 * k}, {1, 2})
		ring.Rate = if charging then 4 else 0
		ring.Enabled = charging
		inflow.Enabled = charging
		sunLight.Brightness = if elapsed < blastAt then 0.4 + 0.8 * k else 0
		if firing then
			local landing = Plan.landing(sun, from:Lerp(to, Plan.progress(elapsed)), params)
			contact.CFrame = CFrame.new(landing)
			if not lastLanding then
				lastLanding = landing
			elseif (landing - lastLanding).Magnitude > 1.6 then
				laySegment(lastLanding, landing)
				lastLanding = landing
			end
			-- The lance thins in its last tenth of a second, collapsing.
			local pinch = 1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, blastAt - 0.12, blastAt) * 0.85
			local flicker = 0.92 + 0.08 * math.sin(elapsed * 60)
			for _, l in ipairs(lances) do
				l.beam.Width1 = l.width * pinch * flicker
				l.beam.Width0 = l.width * 0.7 * pinch
			end
			if os.clock() >= nextShake then
				nextShake = os.clock() + 0.18
				ImpactFX.shake(landing, 0.45, 0.22, 60)
			end
		end
		for _, l in ipairs(lances) do
			if l.beam.Enabled ~= firing then l.beam.Enabled = firing end
		end
		Kit.setEnabled(boiling, firing)
		contactLight.Brightness = if firing then 1.5 else 0
		local age = elapsed - blastAt
		blastLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then math.exp(-age * 4) * 5 else 0
		-- The scar cools from orange to char and its fires die down.
		local cool = if age >= 0 then Kit.ramp(age, 0.4, T.Aftermath - 0.3) else 0
		for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
			Kit.opacity(s.hot, (1 - cool) * 0.9)
			Kit.opacity(s.char, 0.85 * (1 - Kit.ramp(age, T.Aftermath - 0.6, T.Aftermath)))
			if cool > 0.75 then Kit.setEnabled(s.fire, false) end
		end
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(sunHost, SOUND_CHARGE, 0.5, 0.55)
		ImpactFX.punch(payload.origin.Position, 4, T.Charge + 0.2, 60)
	end)
	timeline.at(T.Charge, function()
		Kit.sound(contact, SOUND_BOOM, 0.5, 1.7)
		Kit.sound(sunHost, SOUND_CHARGE, 0.45, 0.8)
		ImpactFX.shake(payload.origin.Position, 1, 0.3, 60)
	end)
	timeline.at(blastAt, function()
		Kit.burst(blast)
		Kit.sound(blastHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.7, 0.95)
		ImpactFX.hit(blastPoint, {tint = EMBER, pattern = "triple", shake = 2.2, shakeDuration = 0.55, punch = 8, radius = 85})
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

local CombatAudio = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.CombatAudio)
-- Skyfall Volley, drawn from one message:
--   draw    jade energy gathers at the caster's bow hand
--   loose   a signal arrow streaks straight up off a burst at their feet
--   mark    two jade rings open on the target, the inner one turning
--   rain    light-arrows streak down inside them, each landing in a small burst
--   finale  a great arrow pins the centre: a jade blast, cubes and a ground
--           shockwave, with impact frames, a shake and a punch
-- Every visible effect is an authored particle or textured Beam; Parts are
-- invisible emitter hosts only.
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.SkyfallPlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Library = require(script.Parent.SkyfallParticles)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local JADE = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 140)
local MINT = Color3.fromRGB(185, 255, 215)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(240, 255, 245)
local ns, curve, colors = Kit.ns, Kit.curve, Kit.colors
local live = 0
local preloaded = false
local POOL = 8

local Sheets = {
	-- Explosions.FinalExplosion "changee": a sharp tapered glow. Along a Beam
	-- it is a streak of light, the hot core of every arrow.
	Spike = {Texture = "rbxassetid://18245342832"},
	-- Slash VFX Trail2: a soft-edged band, laid flat along the circle's beams.
	Band = {Texture = "rbxassetid://16892374733"},
	-- VFX :D.177 Images/circle2: an energetic ring that pulses in the circle.
	Rune = {
		Texture = "rbxassetid://114089808533551",
		FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,
		FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot,
		Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,
		LightEmission = 1,
	},
}

local SOUND_DRAW = CombatAudio.ids.charge_short
local SOUND_THUNK = CombatAudio.ids.impact_body
local SOUND_FINALE = CombatAudio.ids.heavy_whoosh

function VFX.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload(Kit.textures(Library, Sheets), {SOUND_DRAW, SOUND_THUNK, SOUND_FINALE})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)
	return Kit.emitter(if Sheets[kind] then Sheets else Library, kind, parent, props)
end

-- An arrow of light: a solid jade taper fading towards its tail, a hot
-- white streak over it and a glow at the tip, between a head and a tail
-- attachment that the update loop places.
local function arrowRig(folder, name, width, length)
	local host = Kit.host(folder, name, CFrame.new())
	local head = Kit.attachment(host)
	local tail = Kit.attachment(host)
	local function streak(texture, color, w, brightness, z, fade)
		return Kit.beam(host, tail, head, {
			Texture = texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1,
			FaceCamera = true, Segments = 1, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), Width0 = w * 0.2, Width1 = w,
			LightEmission = 1, Brightness = brightness, ZOffset = z, Enabled = false, Transparency = fade or ns(0),
		})
	end
	local tip = emitter("Core", head, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = ns(math.min(width, 1.4) * 1.2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.08),
		Brightness = 2, Rate = 60, LockedToPart = true})
	return {host = host, head = head, tail = tail, length = length, tip = tip,
		beams = {streak("", JADE, width * 1.1, 1.5, 0, curve({0, 1}, {0.6, 0.6}, {1, 0.15})), streak(Sheets.Spike.Texture, WHITE, width * 1.3, 3, 0.1)}}
end

-- A flat ring of four curved beams. A cubic quarter arc is circular when its
-- control points sit 0.5523 of the radius along each end's tangent. Flat
-- particles do not show on this ground, so the circle is drawn in beams.
local function ringBeams(host, width, color, emission)
	local arcs = {}
	for q = 0, 3 do
		local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
		local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
			Texture = Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
			Segments = 16, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
			Brightness = 2.5, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false,
		})
		table.insert(arcs, {beam = beam, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, q = q})
	end
	return arcs
end

local function layoutRing(arcs, radius, opacity)
	for _, arc in ipairs(arcs) do
		local t0, t1 = arc.q * math.pi / 2, (arc.q + 1) * math.pi / 2
		local p0 = Vector3.new(math.cos(t0), 0, math.sin(t0)) * radius
		local p1 = Vector3.new(math.cos(t1), 0, math.sin(t1)) * radius
		-- A beam's width runs along its attachments' Y: radial keeps it flat.
		arc.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(p0, Vector3.new(-math.sin(t0), 0, math.cos(t0)), p0.Unit)
		arc.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(p1, Vector3.new(-math.sin(t1), 0, math.cos(t1)), p1.Unit)
		arc.beam.CurveSize0, arc.beam.CurveSize1 = radius * 0.5523, radius * 0.5523
		Kit.opacity(arc.beam, opacity)
	end
end

local function placeArrow(rig, tip, up, visible)
	rig.head.WorldPosition = tip
	rig.tail.WorldPosition = tip + up * rig.length
	for _, beam in ipairs(rig.beams) do
		if beam.Enabled ~= visible then beam.Enabled = visible end
	end
	if rig.tip.Enabled ~= visible then rig.tip.Enabled = visible end
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.centre) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3"
		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" or type(payload.seed) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = T.FinaleAt + T.Aftermath
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local origin, centre, normal = payload.origin, payload.centre, payload.normal
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "SkyfallVolley"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	local caster = payload.caster
	local character = caster and caster.Character
	local hand = character and (character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm"))
	local handPoint = if hand then hand.Position else (origin * CFrame.new(-1.2, 0.8, -1)).Position

	-- Draw and loose -----------------------------------------------------------
	local drawHost = Kit.host(folder, "Draw", CFrame.new(handPoint))
	local drawAt = Kit.attachment(drawHost, CFrame.lookAt(handPoint, handPoint + up))
	local charge = {
		emitter("Energy", drawAt, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Size = curve({0, 5}, {1, 0.8}), Brightness = 2.5, Rate = 9,
			LockedToPart = true, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top}),
		emitter("Core", drawAt, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = curve({0, 0.8}, {1, 1.4}), Brightness = 1.5, Rate = 12}),
		emitter("CastStar", drawAt, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), Size = curve({0, 3, 0.4}, {1, 1}), Brightness = 2, Rate = 10}),
	}
	local feet = origin.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
	local feetFlat = Kit.attachment(drawHost, CFrame.lookAt(feet, feet + up))
	local loose = {
		{emitter("CastRing", feetFlat, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Size = curve({0, 2}, {0.5, 10}, {1, 14}), Brightness = 2,
			Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular}), 1},
		{emitter("WindRing", feetFlat, {Color = ColorSequence.new(MINT), Size = curve({0, 2}, {1, 12}), Brightness = 1.5,
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front}), 2},
		{emitter("SlashLines", drawAt, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Speed = NumberRange.new(60, 110),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(6, 6), Brightness = 2}), 10},
		{emitter("CastStar", drawAt, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), Size = curve({0, 3.5, 0.5}, {1, 1}), Brightness = 2}), 3},
		{emitter("Glints", drawAt, {Color = ColorSequence.new(MINT), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 60),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40), Brightness = 2}), 12},
	}
	local signal = arrowRig(folder, "Signal", 1.4, 9)

	-- The circle ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local circleFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre + normal * 0.15, centre + normal * 1.15)
	local circleHost = Kit.host(folder, "Circle", circleFrame)
	local flat = Kit.attachment(circleHost, circleFrame)
	local span = T.Radius * 2 + 2
	-- Two crisp rings: the outer one holds still, the inner one turns. Their
	-- hosts stand with Y along the ground normal.
	local side = normal:Cross(Vector3.zAxis)
	side = if side.Magnitude > 0.1 then side.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
	local ringFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(centre + normal * 0.2, side, normal)
	local outerHost = Kit.host(folder, "OuterRing", ringFrame)
	local innerHost = Kit.host(folder, "InnerRing", ringFrame)
	local outer = ringBeams(outerHost, 1.6, MINT, 0.7)
	local outerGlow = ringBeams(outerHost, 4.5, JADE, 1)
	local inner = ringBeams(innerHost, 0.9, WHITE, 0.6)
	local rune = emitter("Rune", flat, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Size = curve({0, span * 0.7}, {1, span * 1.05}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7),
		FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(22), Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Brightness = 1.4,
		Transparency = curve({0, 0.2}, {1, 1}), Rate = 2.5, LockedToPart = true, Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)})
	local glow = emitter("StarLight", flat, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = ns(span * 0.7), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9),
		Rate = 2, Brightness = 0.6, Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.5, 0.85}, {1, 1})})
	local circleLight = Kit.light(circleHost, JADE, T.Radius * 2)

	-- The rain -----------------------------------------------------------------
	local params = Kit.rayParams({folder})
	local arrows = Plan.volley(payload.seed)
	for _, arrow in ipairs(arrows) do
		local column = centre + arrow.offset
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(column + up * 10, -up * 24, params)
		arrow.ground = if hit then hit.Position else column
	end
	local rigs = {}
	for i = 1, POOL do
		local rig = arrowRig(folder, "Arrow" .. i, 1.3, 12)
		local impact = Kit.attachment(rig.host)
		rig.impact = impact
		rig.burst = {
			{emitter("ImpactStar", impact, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), Size = curve({0, 4, 0.6}, {1, 1}), Brightness = 2}), 3},
			{emitter("ImpactSparks", impact, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 28), Brightness = 2,
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(70, 70), LockedToPart = false}), 8},
			{emitter("HitFlash", impact, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = curve({0, 3.5}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 1.5}), 1},
			{emitter("Dust", impact, {Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 200)), Size = curve({0, 1.5}, {1, 3}),
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5), Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(90, 10),
				EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.15, 0.5}, {1, 1})}), 2},
		}
		rigs[i] = rig
	end

	-- The finale ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local great = arrowRig(folder, "GreatArrow", 3.2, 30)
	local finaleHost = Kit.host(folder, "Finale", CFrame.new(centre))
	local core = Kit.attachment(finaleHost, CFrame.new(centre + normal * 1.5))
	local ground = Kit.attachment(finaleHost, circleFrame)
	local finale = {
		{emitter("HitFlash", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(MINT), Size = curve({0, 16}, {1, 0}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2), Brightness = 1.5}), 1},
		{emitter("HitRing", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = curve({0, 3}, {0.55, 18}, {1, 22}), Brightness = 1.6, LightEmission = 1}), 2},
		{emitter("HitEffectRing", core, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 20, 4}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2)}), 4},
		{emitter("HitLines", core, {Color = colors(WHITE, JADE), Speed = NumberRange.new(60, 120), Size = curve({0, 5, 1}, {1, 0})}), 10},
		{emitter("ImpactStar", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Size = curve({0, 14, 2}, {1, 4}), Brightness = 2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.3)}), 4},
		{emitter("ImpactSparks", core, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Speed = NumberRange.new(45, 85), Size = curve({0, 1.6, 0.6}, {1, 0}),
			Brightness = 2, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(80, 80), LockedToPart = false}), 40},
		{emitter("Cubes", core, {Color = colors(MINT, JADE), Speed = NumberRange.new(35, 60), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 1.3, 0.5}, {1, 0}),
			Brightness = 1.5, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -45, 0), LockedToPart = false}), 30},
		{emitter("GroundShock", ground, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Size = curve({0, 8}, {0.3, 24}, {1, 28})}), 2},
		{emitter("WindRing", ground, {Color = ColorSequence.new(MINT), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 24}), Brightness = 1.5,
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front}), 3},
		{emitter("Dust", ground, {Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(205, 220, 205)), Size = curve({0, 3}, {1, 7}), Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 18),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(90, 10), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.1),
			Transparency = curve({0, 1}, {0.1, 0.4}, {1, 1})}), 10},
		{emitter("StarLight", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(JADE), Size = curve({0, 10}, {1, 22}), Brightness = 1.2, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6)}), 2},
	}
	local finaleLight = Kit.light(finaleHost, JADE, 40)

	local landed = {}
	local nextRig = 1
	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		-- The rings open out, turn while the rain falls, and fade after the finale.
		local open = Kit.smooth((elapsed - T.MarkAt) / 0.25)
		local shown = if elapsed < T.MarkAt then 0 else open * (1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, T.FinaleAt + 0.15, T.FinaleAt + 0.55))
		local reach = T.Radius * (0.45 + 0.55 * open)
		layoutRing(outer, reach, shown)
		layoutRing(outerGlow, reach, shown * 0.45)
		layoutRing(inner, reach * 0.72, shown * 0.9)
		innerHost.CFrame = ringFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, elapsed * 1.4, 0)
		-- The draw, then the signal arrow climbing out of sight.
		Kit.setEnabled(charge, elapsed < T.Draw)
		local rising = elapsed >= T.Draw and elapsed < T.Draw + T.Rise
		if rising then
			local p = (elapsed - T.Draw) / T.Rise
			placeArrow(signal, handPoint + up * (4 + 70 * p * p), -up, true)
		else
			placeArrow(signal, handPoint, -up, false)
		end
		local marking = elapsed >= T.MarkAt and elapsed < T.FinaleAt + 0.2
		rune.Enabled, glow.Enabled = marking, marking
		circleLight.Brightness = if marking then 0.6 + 0.25 * math.sin(elapsed * 9) else 0
		-- Arrows in flight take a rig each; landing frees it with a burst.
		for index, arrow in ipairs(arrows) do
			if elapsed >= arrow.at and not landed[index] then
				if not arrow.rig then
					arrow.rig = rigs[nextRig]
					nextRig = nextRig % POOL + 1
				end
				local p = math.clamp((elapsed - arrow.at) / T.Fall, 0, 1)
				if p >= 1 then
					landed[index] = true
					placeArrow(arrow.rig, arrow.ground, up, false)
					arrow.rig.impact.WorldPosition = arrow.ground + up * 0.4
					if elapsed - arrow.lands < 0.25 then
						Kit.burst(arrow.rig.burst)
						if index % 3 == 0 then Kit.sound(arrow.rig.host, SOUND_THUNK, 0.22, 0.9 + (index % 5) * 0.08) end
						ImpactFX.shake(arrow.ground, 0.18, 0.12, 40)
					end
				else
					placeArrow(arrow.rig, arrow.ground + up * T.DropHeight * (1 - p) * (1 - p * 0.3), up, true)
				end
			end
		end
		-- The great arrow.
		local fall = (elapsed - T.FinaleAt) / T.FinaleFall
		if fall >= 0 and fall < 1 then
			placeArrow(great, centre + up * (60 * (1 - fall * fall)), up, true)
		else
			placeArrow(great, centre, up, false)
		end
		local age = elapsed - T.FinaleAt - T.FinaleFall
		finaleLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then math.exp(-age * 4) * 4 else 0
	end, {folder})

-- A stroke lying flat in its host's XZ plane. A beam bends along its
-- attachments' X axes and spreads its width along their Y axes, so Y points
-- across the stroke on the ground.
local function stroke(host, width, color, emission, z)
	local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
	local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
		Texture = Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
		Segments = 12, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
		Brightness = if emission > 0.5 then 2 else 1, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false, ZOffset = z or 0,
	})
	return {beam = beam, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, width = width}
end

local function radial(theta)
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
end

-- A whole circle in four quarter arcs; a cubic quarter arc is circular when
-- its control points sit 0.5523 of the radius along each end's tangent.
local function circle(host, width, color, emission, z)
	local arcs = {}
	for q = 1, 4 do arcs[q] = stroke(host, width, color, emission, z) end
	return arcs
end

local function layoutCircle(arcs, radius, opacity, widthScale)
	for q, s in ipairs(arcs) do
		local t0, t1 = (q - 1) * math.pi / 2, q * math.pi / 2
		s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t0) * radius, radial(t0 + math.pi / 2), radial(t0))
		s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t1) * radius, radial(t1 + math.pi / 2), radial(t1))
		s.beam.CurveSize0, s.beam.CurveSize1 = radius * 0.5523, radius * 0.5523
		local width = s.width * (widthScale or 1)
		s.beam.Width0, s.beam.Width1 = width, width
		Kit.opacity(s.beam, if radius > 0.1 then opacity else 0)
	end
end

local function outward(t)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
end

		emitters = {

				Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), LockedToPart = false,
				Rate = 25}),
		},

				Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.3}, {1, 1}), WidthScale = curve({0, 1}, {0.3, 0.8}, {1, 0.15})}),

function VFX.play(payload, scope)

		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" or type(payload.seed) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end

	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end

	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)

		{emitter("Crescents", back, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 7}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4), Brightness = 3}), 4},
		{emitter("Puff", back, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.4, 4}, {1, 4.5}), Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 16),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), LightEmission = 0.3, LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = false}), 8},
		{emitter("Embers", back, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.4}, {1, 0}), Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 22),
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), LockedToPart = false}), 20},

		starts[i] = {emitter("Billow", Kit.attachment(casterHost, CFrame.new(serpent.start)), {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON),
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 4}, {1, 3}), Speed = NumberRange.new(-20, 20), LightEmission = 0.3, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 1.5}), 3}
	end

	-- The serpents and their strikes ------------------------------------------------------
	local rigs, strikes, scorches = {}, {}, {}
	local strikeHost = Kit.host(folder, "Strikes", CFrame.new(centre))
	for i, landing in ipairs(landings) do
		rigs[i] = serpentRig(folder, i)
		local at = Kit.attachment(strikeHost, CFrame.new(landing + up * 1.2))
		strikes[i] = {
			{emitter("Glare", at, {Color = colors(HOT, GOLD), Size = curve({0, 14}, {1, 0}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25), Brightness = 2}), 1},
			{emitter("Puff", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.4, 5}, {1, 5.5}), Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20),
				SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), LightEmission = 0.3, LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = false}), 6},
			{emitter("Billow", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 7}, {1, 5}), LightEmission = 0.3,
				LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 1.5}), 5},
			{emitter("Sparks", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 60), Size = curve({0, 1}, {1, 0}),
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.9), LightInfluence = 0}), 14},
			{emitter("Crescents", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 5}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35), Brightness = 3}), 3},
			{emitter("Smoke", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SOOT), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 5}, {1, 4}), LightInfluence = 0,
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.8)}), 3},
		}
		local scorchHost = Kit.host(folder, "Scorch" .. i, CFrame.new(landing + up * 0.15))
		-- A band wider than its radius overlaps itself: a soft filled scorch.
		scorches[i] = circle(scorchHost, 3.6, SOOT, 0, 0)
	end

	-- The ring of fire ----------------------------------------------------------------
	local ringHost = Kit.host(folder, "Ring", CFrame.new(centre + up * 0.2))
	local band = circle(ringHost, 2.5, CRIMSON, 0.3, 0.1)
	local bandGlow = circle(ringHost, 6, FLAME, 1, 0)
	local wall = {}
	for i = 1, 12 do
		local at = Kit.attachment(ringHost)
		wall[i] = {at = at, emitters = {
			emitter("Flame", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 3}, {1, 1.2}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5),
