				LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = false, Rate = 18}),
			emitter("Flicker", at, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 1.6, 0.4}, {1, 0.4}), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
				LightInfluence = 0, Rate = 10}),
		}}
	end

	-- The eruption ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local base = Kit.attachment(ringHost, CFrame.new(centre))
	local top = Kit.attachment(ringHost, CFrame.new(centre))
	local function column(kind, width, color, emission, z)
		return {width = width, beam = Kit.beam(ringHost, base, top, {Texture = Library[kind].Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch,
			TextureLength = 1, TextureSpeed = 2, Color = color, LightEmission = emission, Brightness = 2, FaceCamera = true, Segments = 1,
			Width0 = width, Width1 = width, ZOffset = z, Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1}), Enabled = false})}
	end
	local pillar = {
		column("TrailFlame", 14, colors(FLAME, CRIMSON), 0.2, 0),
		column("TrailFlame", 9, colors(GOLD, FLAME), 0.4, 0.05),
		column("TrailWisp", 7, colors(GOLD, FLAME), 0.8, 0.1),
		column("TrailCore", 2.4, colors(HOT, GOLD), 1, 0.2),
	}
	local eruptAtt = Kit.attachment(ringHost, CFrame.new(centre + up * 2))
	local whirl = {
		emitter("Spin", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 2}, {1, 14}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(25, 40), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, LightEmission = 0.6, LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = false, Rate = 14}),
		emitter("SpinWide", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(HOT, GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 3}, {1, 18}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 45), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, LightEmission = 0.8, LightInfluence = 0, LockedToPart = false, Rate = 8}),
	}
	local erupt = {
		{emitter("Glare", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 18}, {1, 0}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25), Brightness = 1.5}), 1},
		{emitter("Shockwave", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 30}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35),
			Brightness = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Transparency = curve({0, 0.45}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("Billow", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 14}, {1, 10}), LightEmission = 0.3,
			LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = 1.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60)}), 14},
		{emitter("Puff", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME, CRIMSON), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.4, 7}, {1, 8}), Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 50),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25), LightEmission = 0.3, LightInfluence = 0, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8),
			LockedToPart = false}), 12},
		{emitter("Sparks", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Speed = NumberRange.new(60, 120), Size = curve({0, 1.6}, {1, 0}),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2), LightInfluence = 0}), 40},
		{emitter("Crescents", eruptAtt, {Color = colors(GOLD, FLAME), Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 9}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45), Brightness = 3}), 6},
		{emitter("Smoke", eruptAtt, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SOOT), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.12, 12}, {1, 10}), LightInfluence = 0,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.5, 2.2), Speed = NumberRange.new(-30, 30)}), 8},
	}
	local shock = circle(ringHost, 2.5, GOLD, 1, 0.2)
	local shockGlow = circle(ringHost, 7, FLAME, 1, 0.1)
	local light = Kit.light(ringHost, FLAME, 50)

	local spin = 0
	local last
	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local dt = if last then math.max(elapsed - last, 0) else 0
		last = elapsed
		-- The serpents in flight.
		for i, serpent in ipairs(serpents) do
			local rig = rigs[i]
			local t = (elapsed - serpent.launch) / serpent.flight
			local flying = t >= 0 and t < 1
			if flying then
				local position = Plan.path(serpent, landings[i], t)
				local ahead = Plan.path(serpent, landings[i], math.min(1, t + 0.03))
				rig.host.CFrame = if (ahead - position).Magnitude > 0.01 then CFrame.lookAt(position, ahead) else CFrame.new(position)
			end
			Kit.setEnabled(rig.emitters, flying)
			for _, trail in ipairs(rig.trails) do
				if trail.Enabled ~= flying then trail.Enabled = flying end
			end
			local landed = elapsed >= Plan.landsAt(serpent)
			layoutCircle(scorches[i], 1.4, if landed then 0.55 * (1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, eruptAt, total)) else 0)
		end
		-- The ring catches and closes in, turning.
		local close = Kit.smooth((elapsed - igniteAt) / T.Collapse)
		local burning = elapsed >= igniteAt and elapsed < eruptAt
		local radius = R * (1 - close) + 0.1
		local catch = Kit.smooth((elapsed - igniteAt) / 0.12)
		layoutCircle(band, radius, if burning then catch else 0)
		layoutCircle(bandGlow, radius, if burning then 0.6 * catch else 0)
		spin += dt * (2 + 6 * close)
		for i, flame in ipairs(wall) do
			flame.at.Position = radial(spin + (i - 1) / #wall * math.pi * 2) * radius
			Kit.setEnabled(flame.emitters, burning)
		end
		-- The column shoots up, swells and burns out.
		local age = elapsed - eruptAt
		local rising = age >= 0 and age < 0.9
		local height = T.ColumnHeight * outward(age / 0.15)
		local swell = if age >= 0 then (1 + 0.4 * math.exp(-age * 8)) * (1 - Kit.ramp(age, 0.5, 0.9)) else 0
		top.WorldPosition = centre + up * math.max(height, 0.1)
		for _, col in ipairs(pillar) do
			local width = col.width * swell
			col.beam.Width0, col.beam.Width1 = width, width * 1.3
			local on = rising and width > 0.05
			if col.beam.Enabled ~= on then col.beam.Enabled = on end
		end
		Kit.setEnabled(whirl, age >= 0 and age < 0.7)
		local wave = age / 0.45
		local waveOn = wave >= 0 and wave <= 1
		layoutCircle(shock, 2 + 20 * outward(wave), if waveOn then 1 - wave else 0, 1 - 0.7 * math.clamp(wave, 0, 1))
		layoutCircle(shockGlow, 2 + 18 * outward(wave), if waveOn then 0.5 * (1 - wave) else 0)
		light.Brightness = if burning then 1.5 * catch elseif age >= 0 then 6 * math.exp(-age * 4) else 0
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.burst(rouse)
		Kit.sound(casterHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.5, 0.7)
		ImpactFX.shake(origin.Position, 0.4, 0.2, 40)
	end)
	for i, serpent in ipairs(serpents) do
		timeline.at(serpent.launch, function()
			Kit.burst({starts[i]})
			if i % 2 == 1 then Kit.sound(casterHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.3, 1.1 + i * 0.05) end
		end)
		timeline.at(Plan.landsAt(serpent), function()
			Kit.burst(strikes[i])
			Kit.sound(strikeHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.35, 1.3 + (i % 3) * 0.1)
			ImpactFX.shake(landings[i], 0.5, 0.15, 60)
		end)
	end
	timeline.at(igniteAt, function()
		Kit.sound(ringHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.5, 0.6)
	end)
	timeline.at(eruptAt, function()
		Kit.burst(erupt)
		Kit.sound(ringHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.8, 0.8)
		Kit.sound(ringHost, SOUND_HIT, 0.5, 0.7)
		ImpactFX.hit(centre + up * 3, {tint = FLAME, pattern = "triple", shake = 2.4, shakeDuration = 0.6, punch = 8, radius = 90})
	end)
	return true
end

end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = T.CutAt + T.Aftermath
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 4 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local origin = payload.origin
	local facing = Kit.flat(origin.LookVector)
	local centre = origin.Position + Vector3.new(0, T.Height, 0)
	local R = T.Radius
	local random = Random.new(payload.seed or 3)
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "SumiWhirl"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	local host = Kit.host(folder, "Ring", CFrame.new(centre))

	-- The ring ----------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Twelve arcs, each a band standing upright (an attachment's Y is the
	-- beam's width), so the stroke reads as a wall of ink from any side.
	-- Widths taper along the stroke like a brush lifting off the page.
	local sweep = math.pi * 2 / ARCS
	local arcs = {}
	for i = 1, ARCS do
		local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
		local from, to = (i - 1) / ARCS, i / ARCS
		local w0, w1 = 3.4 * (1 - 0.62 * from), 3.4 * (1 - 0.62 * to)
		local arc = {a0 = a0, a1 = a1, from = from, to = to, beams = {}}
		local function band(texture, color, scale, emission, z)
			local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
				Texture = texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
				Segments = 10, Width0 = w0 * scale, Width1 = w1 * scale, Color = ColorSequence.new(color),
				LightEmission = emission, Brightness = 1, ZOffset = z, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false,
			})
			table.insert(arc.beams, beam)
			return beam
		end
		arc.wash = band(Sheets.Band.Texture, WASH, 1.9, 0, 0)
		arc.ink = band(Sheets.Stroke.Texture, INK, 1.35, 0, 0.05)
		-- An untextured beam is a solid band: the stroke's dense middle.
		arc.core = band("", INK, 0.24, 0, 0.1)
		arc.flash = band(Sheets.Band.Texture, PAPER, 0.7, 1, 0.15)
		arcs[i] = arc
	end
	local function place(attachment, along)
		local a = Plan.angle(facing, along)
		local radial = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, -math.sin(a))
		-- Tangent in the direction the stroke runs.
		local tangent = Vector3.new(math.sin(a), 0, math.cos(a))
		attachment.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial * R, tangent, Vector3.yAxis)
		return radial, tangent
	end

	-- The brush ---------------------------------------------------------------
	local brush = Kit.attachment(host)
	local spatter = {
		emitter("SplatterWild", brush, {Color = colors(INK, WASH), Size = curve({0, 0.4}, {1, 2.4, 0.3}), Rate = 70,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 22), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -60, 0),
			LightInfluence = 0, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Right, Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1})}),
		emitter("Blob", brush, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), Size = curve({0, 0.4}, {1, 0.7, 0.2}), Rate = 50,
			Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 26), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -55, 0),
			LightInfluence = 0, EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Right, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), Transparency = ns(0)}),
		emitter("SpecsDark", brush, {Speed = NumberRange.new(16, 34), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(40, 40), Rate = 40,
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 0.9, 0.4}, {1, 0}), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Right, Drag = 4}),
	}

	-- The cut -----------------------------------------------------------------
	local cutLayers = {}
	for i = 1, CUTS do
		local along = (i - 0.5) / CUTS
		local a = Plan.angle(facing, along)
		local radial = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, -math.sin(a))
		local at = Kit.attachment(host)
		-- Front points outward, so directional emitters throw away from the caster.
		at.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(radial * R, radial * (R + 1))
		local high = Kit.attachment(host)
		high.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(radial * R + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), radial * (R + 1) + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0))
		local spin = NumberRange.new(math.deg(a) + random:NextNumber(-25, 25))
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("Halftone", high, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), Size = curve({0, 9}, {1, 12}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.32),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(40), LightInfluence = 0, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Rotation = spin, ZOffset = 1}), 1})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("DarkSlash", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), Size = curve({0, 5}, {1, 7}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(44), LightInfluence = 0, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01),
			Rotation = NumberRange.new(-30, 30)}), 1})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("SlashLines", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(PAPER), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front,
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(12, 12), Speed = NumberRange.new(55, 95), Brightness = 2}), 4})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("Splatter", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), Size = curve({0, 3}, {1, 6, 0.6}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.8),
			Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera, LightInfluence = 0, Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 9),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -14, 0)}), 2})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("ShardsDark", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front,
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25), Speed = NumberRange.new(70, 130), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.25, 2, 2}, {1, 0})}), 5})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("SplatterWild", at, {Color = if i % 3 == 0 then colors(SEAL, INK) else colors(INK, WASH),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(45, 45), Speed = NumberRange.new(16, 30),
			Size = curve({0, 0.6}, {1, 3, 0.3}), LightInfluence = 0, Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1})}), 8})
		table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("Smoke", at, {Color = colors(WASH, INK), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 4, 0.5}, {1, 5.5, 0.5}),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 20), Transparency = curve({0, 0.5}, {0.5, 0.85}, {1, 1}), LockedToPart = false,
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)}), 4})
	end
	local core = Kit.attachment(host)
	core.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("HitFlash", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(PAPER), Size = curve({0, 4.5}, {1, 0}), Brightness = 1.5, LightEmission = 0.6}), 1})
	table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("HitLines", core, {Color = colors(PAPER, INK), Speed = NumberRange.new(70, 120), Size = curve({0, 5, 1}, {1, 0}),
		SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 10), LightEmission = 0.3}), 14})
	table.insert(cutLayers, {emitter("Splatter", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SEAL), Size = curve({0, 1.5}, {1, 3}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5),
		Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera, LightInfluence = 0}), 1})

	-- The bleed: drops falling off the ring and wash rising.
	local bleed = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local at = Kit.attachment(host)
		place(at, (i - 0.5) / 4)
		at.Position = at.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
		table.insert(bleed, emitter("Drops", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(INK), Size = curve({0, 0.9}, {1, 0.6}), Rate = 9,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.9), Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 4), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), LightInfluence = 0,
			Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box}))
	end
	local mist = emitter("Smoke", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(WASH), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 9}), Rate = 6, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.3), Transparency = curve({0, 0.7}, {1, 1}), Drag = 1, LockedToPart = false,
		EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)})

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local painted = Plan.painted(elapsed)
		local age = elapsed - T.CutAt
		-- Ink holds until the cut, flashes white for a beat, then fades out
		-- while the band swells a little, the ink running.
		local flash = if age >= 0 then 1 - Kit.ramp(age, 0.03, 0.14) else 0
		local fade = if age >= 0 then 1 - Kit.ramp(age, 0.35, T.Aftermath - 0.2) else 1
		local swell = 1 + (if age >= 0 then Kit.smooth(age / 1.2) * 0.35 else 0)
		for _, arc in ipairs(arcs) do
			local shown = math.clamp((painted - arc.from) / (arc.to - arc.from), 0, 1)
			if shown > 0 then
				local endAlong = arc.from + (arc.to - arc.from) * shown
				place(arc.a0, arc.from)
				place(arc.a1, endAlong)
				local k = control(sweep * shown, R)
				-- Both ends' tangents run along the stroke, so both sizes are positive.
				for _, beam in ipairs(arc.beams) do
					beam.CurveSize0, beam.CurveSize1 = k, k
				end
			end
			local visible = if shown > 0 then 1 else 0
			Kit.opacity(arc.ink, visible * fade * 0.97)
			Kit.opacity(arc.core, visible * fade * 0.92)
			Kit.opacity(arc.wash, visible * fade * 0.4)
			Kit.opacity(arc.flash, visible * flash)
			arc.ink.Width0, arc.ink.Width1 = 4.6 * (1 - 0.62 * arc.from) * swell, 4.6 * (1 - 0.62 * arc.to) * swell
		end
		local radial = place(brush, painted)
		brush.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial * R + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), radial, Vector3.yAxis)
		Kit.setEnabled(spatter, elapsed >= T.Windup and painted < 0.98)
		Kit.setEnabled(bleed, age >= 0.15 and age < T.Aftermath - 0.6)
		mist.Enabled = age >= 0.1 and age < T.Aftermath - 0.7
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(host, SOUND_SWISH, 0.5, 0.85)
	end)
	timeline.at(T.Windup + T.Stroke * 0.5, function()
		Kit.sound(host, SOUND_SWISH, 0.4, 1.15)
	end)
	timeline.at(T.CutAt, function()
		Kit.burst(cutLayers)
		Kit.sound(host, SOUND_CUT, 0.55, 1.35)
		Kit.sound(host, SOUND_HIT, 0.5, 0.8)
		ImpactFX.hit(centre, {tint = Color3.fromRGB(70, 60, 90), pattern = "triple", shake = 1.8, shakeDuration = 0.45,
			punch = -6, punchDuration = 0.35, radius = 70, silhouetteRadius = T.Reach + 6})
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

local CombatAudio = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.CombatAudio)
-- Tidecaller, drawn from two kinds of message:
--   summon  the caster stamps a tide pool open at their feet: mist, a toon
--           splash and a ring; the pool ripples and bubbles, and eight water
--           orbs rise out of it to circle the caster
--   shot    one orb leaves the circle and arcs onto its target as a water
--           bolt trailing a ribbon of spray, landing in a toon splash with a
--           ripple ring and a shake; the last bolt adds impact frames and a
--           punch
-- Every visible effect is an authored particle, Beam or Trail; Parts are
-- invisible emitter hosts only.
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.TidePlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Library = require(script.Parent.TideParticles)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local FOAM = Color3.fromRGB(225, 245, 255)
local AQUA = Color3.fromRGB(60, 175, 255)
local DEEPWATER = Color3.fromRGB(20, 85, 190)
local ns, curve, colors = Kit.ns, Kit.curve, Kit.colors
local live = 0
local preloaded = false
-- Summons still circling, by cast id, so each shot can take its orb.
local rigs = {}

local Sheets = {
	-- Slash VFX Trail2: a soft-edged band, laid flat for the pool's rings.
	Band = {Texture = "rbxassetid://16892374733"},
}

local SOUND_WATER = CombatAudio.ids.water_walk
local SOUND_SWISH = CombatAudio.ids.swing_air

function VFX.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload(Kit.textures(Library, Sheets), {SOUND_WATER, SOUND_SWISH})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)
	return Kit.emitter(if Sheets[kind] then Sheets else Library, kind, parent, props)
end

-- A stroke lying flat in its host's XZ plane. A beam bends along its
-- attachments' X axes and spreads its width along their Y axes, so Y points
-- across the stroke on the ground. An untextured stroke is a solid band.
local function stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
	local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
		Texture = texture or Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
		Segments = 12, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
		Brightness = if emission > 0.5 then 2 else 1, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false, ZOffset = z or 0,
	})
	return {beam = beam, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, width = width}
end

local function radial(theta)
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
end

-- A whole circle in four quarter arcs; a cubic quarter arc is circular when
-- its control points sit 0.5523 of the radius along each end's tangent.
local function circle(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local arcs = {}
	for q = 1, 4 do arcs[q] = stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture) end
	return arcs
end

local function layoutCircle(arcs, radius, opacity, widthScale)
	for q, s in ipairs(arcs) do
		local t0, t1 = (q - 1) * math.pi / 2, q * math.pi / 2
		s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t0) * radius, radial(t0 + math.pi / 2), radial(t0))
		s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t1) * radius, radial(t1 + math.pi / 2), radial(t1))
		s.beam.CurveSize0, s.beam.CurveSize1 = radius * 0.5523, radius * 0.5523
		local width = s.width * (widthScale or 1)
		s.beam.Width0, s.beam.Width1 = width, width
		Kit.opacity(s.beam, if radius > 0.05 then opacity else 0)
	end
end

local function outward(t)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
end

local function summon(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.pool) ~= "Vector3" or type(payload.id) ~= "string"
		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = Plan.duration()
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 4 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local pool = payload.pool
	local R = T.PoolRadius
	local caster = payload.caster
	local character = caster and caster.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "Tidecaller"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- The stamp -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local poolFrame = CFrame.new(pool + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0))
	local poolHost = Kit.host(folder, "Pool", poolFrame)
	local feet = Kit.attachment(poolHost, CFrame.new(pool + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)))
	local stamp = {
		{emitter("Splash", feet, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = ns(9), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5), LightEmission = 0.2,
			LightInfluence = 0}), 2},
		{emitter("Spray", feet, {Size = ns(10), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6), LightInfluence = 0}), 2},
		{emitter("Ring", feet, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = curve({0, 2}, {1, 22}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35), Brightness = 1.5}), 1},
		{emitter("Mist", feet, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = curve({0, 3}, {1, 7}), Speed = NumberRange.new(14, 22),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8), Drag = 4, LightInfluence = 0.3, Brightness = 1}), 10},
		{emitter("Dots", feet, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
			EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.6}, {1, 0}),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)}), 16},
	}

	-- The pool --------------------------------------------------------------------
	local surface = circle(poolHost, R, DEEPWATER, 0, -0.1, "")
	local rim = circle(poolHost, 1.2, AQUA, 0.3, 0.1)
	local rimGlow = circle(poolHost, 3.5, FOAM, 1, 0)
	local ripples = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do ripples[i] = circle(poolHost, 0.6, FOAM, 0.6, 0.15) end
	local floor = Kit.host(folder, "Floor", poolFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 0), Vector3.new(R * 1.4, 0.2, R * 1.4))
	local bubbling = {
		emitter("Bubble", floor, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = ns(1.4), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8), LightInfluence = 0,
			ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume, Rate = 6}),
		emitter("Dots", floor, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.4}, {1, 0}), ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume, Rate = 10}),
	}
	local poolLight = Kit.light(poolHost, AQUA, 22)

	-- The orbs --------------------------------------------------------------------
	local orbs = {}
	for i = 1, T.Shots do
		local host = Kit.host(folder, "Orb" .. i, CFrame.new(pool))
		local at = Kit.attachment(host)
		orbs[i] = {host = host, emitters = {
			emitter("Swirl", at, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = curve({0, 1.6}, {1, 2.4}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4), Rate = 16,
				LockedToPart = true, LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.2}),
			emitter("Bubble", at, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = ns(2.2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2), Rate = 3, LockedToPart = true,
				LightInfluence = 0}),
			emitter("Flare", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(AQUA), Size = ns(3), Rate = 8, LockedToPart = true}),
			emitter("Dots", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 2), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.4}, {1, 0}),
				Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.8), Rate = 6}),
		}}
	end
	local rig = {fired = {}}
	rigs[payload.id] = rig
	scope:add(function()
		if rigs[payload.id] == rig then rigs[payload.id] = nil end
	end)

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local open = outward(elapsed / 0.35)
		local fade = 1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, total - 0.6, total)
		local reach = R * open
		layoutCircle(surface, reach * 0.5, 0.35 * fade, 0.98 * open)
		layoutCircle(rim, reach, fade)
		layoutCircle(rimGlow, reach, 0.4 * fade)
		for i, ring in ipairs(ripples) do
			local p = ((elapsed + i * 0.45) % 1.35) / 1.35
			layoutCircle(ring, R * p, if elapsed > 0.3 then 0.6 * (1 - p) * fade else 0)
		end
		Kit.setEnabled(bubbling, elapsed > 0.2 and elapsed < total - 0.5)
		poolLight.Brightness = 1.2 * fade * open
		local centre = if root and root.Parent then root.Position else payload.origin.Position
		for i, orb in ipairs(orbs) do
			local shown = not rig.fired[i] and elapsed > 0.15
			Kit.setEnabled(orb.emitters, shown)
			if shown then orb.host.CFrame = CFrame.new(Plan.orbit(centre, i, elapsed)) end
		end
	end, {folder})
	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.burst(stamp)
		Kit.sound(poolHost, SOUND_WATER, 0.6, 0.8)
		ImpactFX.shake(pool, 0.6, 0.25, 50)
	end)
	return true
end

local function shot(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.from) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.landing) ~= "Vector3" or type(payload.index) ~= "number"
		or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" or type(payload.seed) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = T.Flight + 1.1
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total then return false end
	local rig = type(payload.id) == "string" and rigs[payload.id]
	if rig then rig.fired[payload.index] = true end
	VFX.preload()

	local from, landing = payload.from, payload.landing
	local rng = Random.new(payload.seed)
	local final = payload.index == T.Shots
	local scale = if final then 1.5 else 1
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "TidecallerBolt"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- The bolt --------------------------------------------------------------------
	local boltHost = Kit.host(folder, "Bolt", CFrame.new(from))
	local core = Kit.attachment(boltHost)
	local top, bottom = Kit.attachment(boltHost), Kit.attachment(boltHost)
	top.Position, bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.8, 0)
	local body = {
		emitter("Swirl", core, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = curve({0, 2.4}, {1, 1.2}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3), Rate = 40,
			LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.2}),
		emitter("Bubble", core, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = ns(2.6), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6), Rate = 6, LockedToPart = true,
			LightInfluence = 0}),
		emitter("Flare", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(AQUA), Size = ns(3.5), Rate = 12, LockedToPart = true}),
		emitter("Dots", core, {Color = ColorSequence.new(FOAM), Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 4), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.5}, {1, 0}),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), Rate = 30}),
	}
	local ribbon = {
		Kit.trail(boltHost, top, bottom, {Texture = Library.Stream.Texture, Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA, DEEPWATER), LightEmission = 0.2,
			FaceCamera = true, Lifetime = 0.22, Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {1, 1}), WidthScale = curve({0, 1}, {1, 0.3}), Enabled = false}),
		Kit.trail(boltHost, top, bottom, {Texture = Library.StreamGlow.Texture, Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), LightEmission = 1,
			FaceCamera = true, Lifetime = 0.15, Transparency = curve({0, 0.3}, {1, 1}), WidthScale = curve({0, 0.6}, {1, 0.2}), Enabled = false}),
	}

	-- The splash ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local landHost = Kit.host(folder, "Landing", CFrame.new(landing + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)))
	local splashAt = Kit.attachment(landHost, CFrame.new(landing + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)))
	local splash = {
		{emitter("Splash", splashAt, {Color = colors(FOAM, AQUA), Size = ns(7 * scale), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45), LightEmission = 0.2,

			local ahead = Plan.arc(from, landing, math.min(1, t + 0.05))
			boltHost.CFrame = if (ahead - position).Magnitude > 0.01 then CFrame.lookAt(position, ahead) else CFrame.new(position)

		for _, trail in ipairs(ribbon) do
			if trail.Enabled ~= flying then trail.Enabled = flying end
		end
		local age = elapsed - T.Flight
		local wave = age / 0.5
		local waveOn = wave >= 0 and wave <= 1
		local reach = 1 + 7 * scale * outward(wave)
		layoutCircle(ripple, reach, if waveOn then 1 - wave else 0)
		layoutCircle(rippleGlow, reach, if waveOn then 0.5 * (1 - wave) else 0)

	end, {folder})
	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(boltHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.25, rng:NextNumber(1.2, 1.5))
	end)
	timeline.at(T.Flight, function()
		Kit.burst(splash)
		Kit.sound(landHost, SOUND_WATER, 0.45, rng:NextNumber(0.85, 1.15))
		if final then
			ImpactFX.hit(landing, {tint = AQUA, pattern = "double", shake = 1.2, shakeDuration = 0.35, punch = 4, radius = 70})
		else
			ImpactFX.shake(landing, 0.45, 0.15, 50)
		end
	end)
	return true
end

	if payload.phase == "shot" then return shot(payload, scope) end

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)

-- A stroke lying flat in its host's XZ plane. A beam bends along its
-- attachments' X axes and spreads its width along their Y axes, so Y points
-- across the stroke on the ground.
local function stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local a0, a1 = Kit.attachment(host), Kit.attachment(host)
	local beam = Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, {
		Texture = texture or Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
		Segments = 12, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
		Brightness = if emission > 0.5 then 2 else 1, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false, ZOffset = z or 0,
	})
	return {beam = beam, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, width = width}
end

local function radial(theta)
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
end

-- A whole circle in four quarter arcs; a cubic quarter arc is circular when
-- its control points sit 0.5523 of the radius along each end's tangent.
local function circle(host, width, color, emission, z, texture)
	local arcs = {}
	for q = 1, 4 do arcs[q] = stroke(host, width, color, emission, z, texture) end
	return arcs
end

local function layoutCircle(arcs, radius, opacity, widthScale)
	for q, s in ipairs(arcs) do
		local t0, t1 = (q - 1) * math.pi / 2, q * math.pi / 2
		s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t0) * radius, radial(t0 + math.pi / 2), radial(t0))
		s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(radial(t1) * radius, radial(t1 + math.pi / 2), radial(t1))
		s.beam.CurveSize0, s.beam.CurveSize1 = radius * 0.5523, radius * 0.5523
		local width = s.width * (widthScale or 1)
		s.beam.Width0, s.beam.Width1 = width, width
		Kit.opacity(s.beam, if radius > 0.1 then opacity else 0)
	end
end

local function layoutLine(s, from, to, opacity)
	local along = to - from
	if along.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		Kit.opacity(s.beam, 0)
		return
	end
	local across = Vector3.yAxis:Cross(along).Unit
	s.a0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(from, along.Unit, across)
	s.a1.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(to, along.Unit, across)
	Kit.opacity(s.beam, opacity)
end

local function outward(t)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
end

-- A beam between two attachments the update loop places in the world.
local function span(host, a0, a1, props)
	local all = {TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = true, Segments = 1, Enabled = false}
	for key, value in pairs(props) do all[key] = value end
	return Kit.beam(host, a0, a1, all)
end

		end
		-- The blade.
		local h, axis, grow = pose(elapsed)
		local shown = h ~= nil
		if shown then
			local reach = L * grow
			hilt.WorldPosition = h
			tip.WorldPosition = h + axis * math.max(reach, 0.1)
			tipAt.WorldPosition = h + axis * reach
			pommel.WorldPosition = h - axis * 3 * grow
			guardL.WorldPosition = h - side * 3.2 * grow
			guardR.WorldPosition = h + side * 3.2 * grow
			breakAt.WorldPosition = h + axis * (L / 2)
			for _, s in ipairs(sparkles) do s.at.WorldPosition = h + axis * (reach * s.along) end
			for _, layer in ipairs(blade) do
				layer.beam.Width0, layer.beam.Width1 = layer.w0, layer.w1
			end
		end
		for _, layer in ipairs(blade) do
			if layer.beam.Enabled ~= shown then layer.beam.Enabled = shown end
		end
		for _, beam in ipairs(fittings) do
			if beam.Enabled ~= shown then beam.Enabled = shown end
		end
		Kit.setEnabled(gleam, shown)
		for _, s in ipairs(sparkles) do
			local on = shown and grow == 1
			if s.emitter.Enabled ~= on then s.emitter.Enabled = on end
		end
		local turning = elapsed >= turnAt and elapsed < dropAt
		if smear.Enabled ~= turning then smear.Enabled = turning end
		local falling = elapsed >= dropAt and elapsed < impactAt
		if streaks.Enabled ~= falling then streaks.Enabled = falling end
		swordLight.Brightness = if shown then 1.5 else 0
		-- The seal turns under it, flaring at the impact.
		local open = outward((elapsed - 0.1) / 0.5)
		local fade = 1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, rainAt, rainAt + 0.7)
		local flare = if elapsed >= impactAt then 1 + 1.5 * math.exp(-(elapsed - impactAt) * 5) else 1
		local reach = R * open
		local glow = 0.5 * open * fade * flare
		layoutCircle(shade, reach * 0.5, 0.35 * open * fade, 0.98 * open)
		layoutCircle(rim, reach, open * fade)
		layoutCircle(rimGlow, reach, glow)
		layoutCircle(inner, reach * 0.55, open * fade)
		spin += dt * (if elapsed >= impactAt then 0.4 else 1.2)
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local p = Kit.ramp(elapsed, 0.15 + (i - 1) * 0.05, 0.3 + (i - 1) * 0.05)
			local t0 = spin + (i - 1) * math.pi / 4
			local from = radial(t0) * reach * 0.92
			local to = from:Lerp(radial(t0 + 3 * math.pi / 4) * reach * 0.92, p)
			layoutLine(octagram[i], from, to, if p > 0 then open * fade else 0)
			layoutLine(octaGlow[i], from, to, if p > 0 then glow * 0.8 else 0)
		end
		sealLight.Brightness = 1.2 * open * fade * flare
		-- Shock rings out of the impact.
		local wave = (elapsed - impactAt) / 0.45
		local waveOn = wave >= 0 and wave <= 1
		layoutCircle(shock, 2 + 22 * outward(wave), if waveOn then 1 - wave else 0, 1 - 0.7 * math.clamp(wave, 0, 1))
		layoutCircle(shockGlow, 2 + 20 * outward(wave), if waveOn then 0.5 * (1 - wave) else 0)
		-- The shards of the shattered blade arc out and fall.
		for _, shard in ipairs(shards) do
			local t = (elapsed - shatterAt) / shard.flight
			local flying = t >= 0 and t < 1
			if flying then
				local control = (shard.start + shard.landing) / 2 + up * shard.lift
				local position = shard.start:Lerp(control, t):Lerp(control:Lerp(shard.landing, t), t)
				shard.host.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			end
			Kit.setEnabled(shard.body, flying)
			if shard.trail.Enabled ~= flying then shard.trail.Enabled = flying end
		end
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.burst(call)
		Kit.sound(handHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.35, 1.4)
	end)
	for i in ipairs(stars) do
		timeline.at(appear[i], function()

--   gust    a ribbon of petals runs out along the lane from the caster's feet

--           petals and sparkles, with a rising chime

--           with impact frames, a shake and a punch

--           mending sparkles drifting up from it, then fades
-- Every visible effect is an authored particle, trail or textured Beam; Parts
-- are invisible emitter hosts only.
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.BlossomPlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Library = require(script.Parent.BlossomParticles)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local SAKURA = Color3.fromRGB(255, 172, 206)
local BLUSH = Color3.fromRGB(255, 112, 166)
local CREAM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 246)

local preloaded = false

-- VFX :D flipbook sheets and pack textures the curated library does not carry.
local Sheets = {

function VFX.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload(Kit.textures(Library, Sheets), {SOUND_GUST, SOUND_BLOOM, SOUND_FINALE})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

local function emitter(kind, parent, props)
	return Kit.emitter(if Sheets[kind] then Sheets else Library, kind, parent, props)
end

-- Petals tumbling: the toon petal flipbook loops so each petal flutters.
local function petals(parent, props)
	local base = {
		Color = colors(SAKURA, BLUSH), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.1, 1.1, 0.4}, {0.85, 0.9, 0.3}, {1, 0}),
		Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.9), Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 10), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60),
		Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), Drag = 2, Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-220, 220),
		LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0, Brightness = 1, FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop,
		FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(10, 18), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top, LockedToPart = false,
	}
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do base[key] = value end
	return emitter("Petal", parent, base)
end

-- A flat ribbon on the ground between two points (width runs across the lane).
local function groundRibbon(parent, from, to, width, color, emission)
	local forward = Kit.flat(to - from)
	local side = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	local a0 = Kit.attachment(parent, CFrame.fromMatrix(from, forward, side))
	local a1 = Kit.attachment(parent, CFrame.fromMatrix(to, forward, side))
	return Kit.beam(parent, a0, a1, {
		Texture = Sheets.Band.Texture, TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, TextureLength = 1, FaceCamera = false,
		Segments = 2, Width0 = width, Width1 = width, Color = ColorSequence.new(color), LightEmission = emission,
		Brightness = 1.6, ZOffset = 0.1, Transparency = ns(1), Enabled = false,
	})
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.feet) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.direction) ~= "Vector3" or type(payload.points) ~= "table"
		or #payload.points == 0 or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local points = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(payload.points) do
		if typeof(p) ~= "Vector3" or i > T.Blooms then return false end
		points[i] = p
	end
	local finaleAt = Plan.finaleAt(#points)
	local roadEnd = finaleAt + T.Road
	local total = roadEnd + 0.4
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local feet, direction = payload.feet, Plan.flat(payload.direction)
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	local last = points[#points]
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "BlossomRoad"
	folder.Parent = workspace

	-- Cast ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	local castHost = Kit.host(folder, "Cast", CFrame.new(feet))
	local castAt = Kit.attachment(castHost, CFrame.new(feet + up * 1.5))
	local cast = {
		{petals(castAt, {Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 16), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(75, 75)}), 24},
		{emitter("Sparkle", castAt, {Color = colors(CREAM, SAKURA), Size = ns(3), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(30), Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(90, 90), LightInfluence = 0}), 4},
		{emitter("StarLight", castAt, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 9}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5), Brightness = 1}), 1},
	}

	-- Gust: runs along the lane just ahead of the blooms.
	local gust = Kit.host(folder, "Gust", CFrame.new(feet + up * 1.4))
	local gustTop = Kit.attachment(gust); gustTop.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)
	local gustBottom = Kit.attachment(gust); gustBottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.1, 0)
	local gustTrail = Kit.trail(gust, gustTop, gustBottom, {
		Texture = Library.Trail.Texture, TextureMode = Library.Trail.TextureMode, TextureLength = Library.Trail.TextureLength,
		Color = colors(CREAM, SAKURA, BLUSH), Transparency = curve({0, 0.2}, {1, 1}), WidthScale = curve({0, 1}, {1, 0.4}),
		Lifetime = 0.35, LightEmission = 0.6, Brightness = 1.5, FaceCamera = true, Enabled = false,
	})
	local gustAt = Kit.attachment(gust)
	local gustEmitters = {
		petals(gustAt, {Rate = 80, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9, 1.5)}),
		emitter("Pollen", gustAt, {Color = ColorSequence.new(POLLEN), Rate = 30, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9),
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 0.5}), LockedToPart = false}),
	}
	local function lanePoint(t)
		-- Feet to first bloom to last, by distance travelled.
		local path = {feet, table.unpack(points)}
		local lengths, sum = {}, 0
		for i = 1, #path - 1 do
			lengths[i] = (path[i + 1] - path[i]).Magnitude
			sum += lengths[i]
		end
		local want = t * sum
		for i = 1, #path - 1 do
			if want <= lengths[i] or i == #path - 1 then
				return path[i]:Lerp(path[i + 1], math.clamp(want / math.max(lengths[i], 1e-3), 0, 1))
			end
			want -= lengths[i]
		end
		return last
	end

	-- Blooms -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local blooms = {}
	for index, point in ipairs(points) do
		local host = Kit.host(folder, "Bloom" .. index, CFrame.new(point))
		local at = Kit.attachment(host, CFrame.new(point + up * 2.4))
		local low = Kit.attachment(host, CFrame.new(point + up * 0.6))
		local size = 7.5 + index * 0.3
		blooms[index] = {
			host = host,
			layers = {
				{emitter("Flower", at, {Color = colors(SAKURA, BLUSH), Size = curve({0, size * 0.5}, {0.3, size}, {1, size * 1.1}),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9), FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(30), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0, ZOffset = 0.5,
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(-25, 25), Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.75, 0}, {1, 1})}), 1},
				{emitter("Flower", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(CREAM), Size = curve({0, size * 0.25}, {1, size * 0.55}),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.75), FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(36), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.3,
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(20, 70), Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), ZOffset = 0.8}), 1},
				{petals(low, {Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(55, 55)}), 14},
				{emitter("Sparkle", at, {Color = colors(CREAM, SAKURA), Size = ns(2.2), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.6),
					FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(30), Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(120, 120), LightInfluence = 0}), 3},
				{emitter("StarLight", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 8}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45), Brightness = 0.8}), 1},
				{emitter("Pollen", at, {Color = ColorSequence.new(POLLEN), Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 16), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7),
					Size = curve({0, 0}, {1, 0.6}), LockedToPart = false}), 8},
			},
		}
	end

	-- Finale -------------------------------------------------------------------
	local finaleHost = Kit.host(folder, "Finale", CFrame.new(last))
	local crown = Kit.attachment(finaleHost, CFrame.new(last + up * 4))
	local base = Kit.attachment(finaleHost, CFrame.new(last + up * 0.8))
	local finale = {
		{emitter("Flower", crown, {Color = colors(SAKURA, BLUSH), Size = curve({0, 6}, {0.3, 18}, {1, 20}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.1),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(24), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0, ZOffset = 0.5, Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01),
			Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {0.75, 0}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("Flower", crown, {Color = ColorSequence.new(CREAM), Size = curve({0, 4}, {1, 10}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(28), LightInfluence = 0, LightEmission = 0.3, Rotation = NumberRange.new(30, 60),
			Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01), ZOffset = 0.8}), 1},
		{petals(base, {Speed = NumberRange.new(18, 36), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(80, 80), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.2),
			Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.08, 1.4, 0.5}, {0.85, 1.1, 0.4}, {1, 0})}), 60},
		{emitter("Shockwave", crown, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera,
			Size = curve({0, 4}, {0.5, 22}, {1, 28}), Brightness = 1.5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.55), Transparency = curve({0, 0}, {1, 1})}), 1},
		{emitter("HitGlow", crown, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.3, 9}, {1, 12}), Brightness = 0.7}), 1},
		{emitter("HitStar", crown, {Color = colors(CREAM, SAKURA), Size = curve({0, 10, 2}, {1, 3}), Brightness = 1.6,
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.3)}), 4},
		{emitter("Sparkle", crown, {Color = colors(CREAM, SAKURA), Size = ns(3.5), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 0.8),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(24), Speed = NumberRange.new(12, 22), SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Drag = 3, LightInfluence = 0}), 10},
		{emitter("Glints", crown, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 50), Brightness = 2}), 20},
		{emitter("StarLight", crown, {Color = ColorSequence.new(SAKURA), Size = curve({0, 10}, {1, 22}), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7), Brightness = 0.5}), 1},
	}
	local finaleLight = Kit.light(finaleHost, SAKURA, 36)

	-- Road ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	local road = Kit.host(folder, "Road", CFrame.new(feet))
	local ribbons = {}
	local path = {feet, table.unpack(points)}
	for i = 1, #path - 1 do
		local a, b = path[i] + up * 0.15, path[i + 1] + up * 0.15
		local side = Kit.flat(b - a):Cross(up).Unit
		table.insert(ribbons, {beam = groundRibbon(road, a, b, T.RoadWidth * 1.8, SAKURA, 0.6), opacity = 0.35})
		table.insert(ribbons, {beam = groundRibbon(road, a + side * T.RoadWidth * 0.85, b + side * T.RoadWidth * 0.85, 1.6, SAKURA, 1), opacity = 0.85})
		table.insert(ribbons, {beam = groundRibbon(road, a - side * T.RoadWidth * 0.85, b - side * T.RoadWidth * 0.85, 1.6, SAKURA, 1), opacity = 0.85})
	end
	-- One box-shaped host per segment, so drift rises from the whole road.
	local drift = {}
	for i = 1, #path - 1 do
		local a, b = path[i], path[i + 1]
		local mid = (a + b) / 2 + up * 0.4
		local segment = Kit.host(folder, "RoadSegment" .. i, CFrame.lookAt(mid, mid + Kit.flat(b - a)),
			Vector3.new(T.RoadWidth * 1.6, 0.3, math.max((b - a).Magnitude, 1)))
		table.insert(drift, petals(segment, {Rate = 5, Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3), Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
			Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2), Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.15, 0.8, 0.3}, {0.85, 0.7}, {1, 0})}))
		table.insert(drift, emitter("Sparkle", segment, {Color = colors(MEND, CREAM), Size = ns(1.4), Rate = 2.5, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.7, 1),
			FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(18), Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 3), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightInfluence = 0}))
		table.insert(drift, emitter("Health", segment, {Color = ColorSequence.new(MEND), Size = curve({0, 0}, {0.2, 0.7}, {0.8, 0.7}, {1, 0}),
			Rate = 1.2, Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 4), Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.9, 1.2), EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
			SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(10, 10), LightEmission = 0.4, Brightness = 1.5, LockedToPart = false, Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box}))
	end

	local gustEnd = Plan.bloomAt(#points)
	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local running = elapsed < gustEnd + 0.05
		if running then
			gust.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lanePoint(math.clamp(elapsed / gustEnd, 0, 1)) + up * 1.4, lanePoint(1) + up * 1.4)
		end
		gustTrail.Enabled = running
		Kit.setEnabled(gustEmitters, running)
		-- The road fades in behind the gust and out at the end.
		local shown = Kit.ramp(elapsed, 0.1, finaleAt) * (1 - Kit.ramp(elapsed, roadEnd - 0.7, roadEnd))
		for _, ribbon in ipairs(ribbons) do
			Kit.opacity(ribbon.beam, shown * ribbon.opacity * (0.85 + 0.15 * math.sin(elapsed * 4)))
		end
		Kit.setEnabled(drift, elapsed >= finaleAt and elapsed < roadEnd - 0.6)
		local age = elapsed - finaleAt
		finaleLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then math.exp(-age * 4) * 3 else 0
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.burst(cast)
		Kit.sound(castHost, SOUND_GUST, 0.45, 1.5)
	end)
	for index, bloom in ipairs(blooms) do
		timeline.at(Plan.bloomAt(index), function()
			Kit.burst(bloom.layers)
			Kit.sound(bloom.host, SOUND_BLOOM, 0.22, 0.9 + index * 0.07)
			ImpactFX.shake(points[index], 0.25, 0.15, 45)
		end)
	end
	timeline.at(finaleAt, function()
		Kit.burst(finale)
		Kit.sound(finaleHost, SOUND_FINALE, 0.5, 1.4)
		ImpactFX.hit(last, {tint = BLUSH, pattern = "double", shake = 1.5, shakeDuration = 0.45, punch = 5, radius = 75})
	end)
	return true
end

local VIEW_HEIGHT, VIEW_BEYOND = 38, 34
local live = 0
local preloaded = false

local SOUND_SWISH = CombatAudio.ids.plasma_trail
local SOUND_BOOM = CombatAudio.ids.blast_short
local SOUND_HIT = CombatAudio.ids.ice_chunk

function VFX.preload()
	Pack.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload({}, {SOUND_SWISH, SOUND_BOOM, SOUND_HIT})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.sky) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.impact) ~= "Vector3"
		or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3" or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" or type(payload.seed) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = Plan.duration()
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local origin, impact, normal = payload.origin, payload.impact, payload.normal
	-- Drawn from the sky beyond the aim, on screen and coming at the caster,
	-- rather than from the cast's own sky point overhead where the camera never
	-- sees it. It lands on the server's point at the server's moment either way.
	local toward = (impact - origin.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	toward = if toward.Magnitude > 0.1 then toward.Unit else origin.LookVector
	local sky = impact + Vector3.yAxis * VIEW_HEIGHT + toward * VIEW_BEYOND
	local impactAt = Plan.impactAt()
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "AzureComet"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	local function mount(name, cframe, scale, budget)
		return Pack.mount(scope, folder, name, {cframe = cframe, scale = scale, budget = budget, tint = TINT, brightness = 2.5})
	end

	-- A dead caster's comet never lands on the server, so it stops here too.
	Pack.endWithCaster(scope, payload.caster)

	local heading = if (impact - sky).Magnitude > 0.1 then (impact - sky).Unit else -Vector3.yAxis
	local aim = CFrame.lookAt(sky, sky + heading)

	local cometHost = Kit.host(folder, "Comet", aim)
	local comet = Pack.mount(scope, folder, "BZ1Fireball", {cframe = aim, scale = 0.5, budget = 200, tint = TINT, meshTint = BODY, brightness = 2.5, visible = true})
	comet:trailBeams("EFFECTS HOLDER")
	comet:slim(0.42)
	comet:place(aim)
	comet:stream(true)
	comet:beamsOn(true)
	local halo = mount("Impact10", aim, 1.1, 120)
	halo:stream(true)
	halo:beamsOn(true)
	local crackle = mount("LightningSurge", aim, 2.2, 40)
	crackle:stream(true)
	local tail = mount("KiBlast4", aim, 0.6)
	tail:taper(0.15)
	local cometLight = Kit.light(cometHost, CYAN, 30)

	-- The landing, shown the moment the comet leaves the sky.
	local crater = CFrame.lookAt(impact + normal * 1.5, impact + normal * 10)
	local craterHost = Kit.host(folder, "Crater", crater)
	local craterLight = Kit.light(craterHost, CYAN, 55)
	local warning = mount("LightningSurge", crater, 3, 40)

	local across = normal:Cross(heading)
	across = if across.Magnitude > 0.1 then across.Unit else Vector3.xAxis
	local forward = across:Cross(normal).Unit
	local flat = impact + normal * 3
	local streaks = {mount("KiBlast4", crater, 0.9), mount("KiBlast4", crater, 0.55)}
	for _, streak in ipairs(streaks) do streak:taper(0.05) end
	streaks[1]:stretch(flat + across * 45, flat - across * 45)
	streaks[2]:stretch(flat + forward * 26, flat - forward * 26)
	local embers

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local swell = 0.3 + 0.7 * Kit.smooth(elapsed / T.Charge)
		comet:rescale(math.round(swell * 10) / 10 * 1.5)
		local position, along = Plan.flight(sky, impact, elapsed)
		if elapsed < impactAt then
			local frame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + heading)
			comet:place(frame)
			halo:place(frame)
			crackle:place(frame)
			cometHost.CFrame = frame
		end
		local flying = elapsed >= T.Charge and elapsed < impactAt
		tail:beamsOn(flying)
		if flying then
			tail:stretch(position, position - heading * (14 + 40 * along))
		end
		cometLight.Brightness = if elapsed < impactAt then 0.3 + 0.7 * swell else 0
		local age = elapsed - impactAt
		craterLight.Brightness = if age >= 0 then 2.5 * math.exp(-age * 5) else 1.2 * Kit.ramp(elapsed, T.Charge, impactAt)
		local beam = age >= 0 and age < 0.14
		for _, streak in ipairs(streaks) do streak:beamsOn(beam) end
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(cometHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.5, 0.5)
		ImpactFX.shake(origin.Position, 0.25, T.Charge, 50)
	end)
	timeline.at(T.Charge, function()
		mount("Impact12", aim, 1.4):burst(1)
		warning:stream(true)
		Kit.sound(cometHost, SOUND_SWISH, 0.7, 1.1)
		ImpactFX.shake(origin.Position, 0.6, 0.25, 50)
	end)
	timeline.at(impactAt, function()
		comet:clear()
		comet:fade(0)
		halo:clear()
		crackle:clear()
		tail:clear()
		warning:stream(false)
		mount("Impact12", crater, 4.4):burst(1)
		mount("Impact37", crater, 4):burst(1)
		mount("Impact36", crater, 4):burst(1)
		mount("Impact45", crater, 1.3):burst(0.9)
		Pack.bolt(scope, folder, impact, {tint = BOLT, scale = 7, height = 15, width = 26, duration = 0.45})
		embers = mount("LightningSurge", crater, 3, 50)
		embers:stream(true)
		Kit.sound(craterHost, SOUND_BOOM, 0.9, 0.9)
		Kit.sound(craterHost, SOUND_HIT, 0.5, 0.8)
		ImpactFX.hit(impact + normal * 3, {tint = CYAN, pattern = "triple", shake = 2.6, shakeDuration = 0.7, punch = 9, radius = 100})
	end)
	for i = 1, T.Pulses do
		timeline.at(Plan.pulseAt(i), function()
			mount("Impact36", crater, 3):burst(0.9)
			mount("Impact12", crater, 1.5):burst(0.7)
			Pack.bolt(scope, folder, impact, {tint = BOLT, scale = 4.5, height = 10, width = 24, duration = 0.22})
			Kit.sound(craterHost, SOUND_HIT, 0.35, 0.6 + i * 0.1)
			ImpactFX.shake(impact, 0.8, 0.2, 60)
		end)
	end
	timeline.at(Plan.pulseAt(T.Pulses) + 0.25, function()
		if embers then embers:stream(false) end
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

-- Thunderhead, built from complete pack assemblies:
--   gather  the Storm Cloud rolls in over the aim, the world darkens, and
--           Lightning Surge crackles at each spot about to be struck
--   bolts   Stylized Thunder's lightning drops on each spot with a spiky
--           ground splash (Impact #12, #37) and a ring (Impact #36), exactly
--           when the server's hit lands
--   final   the biggest strike in the middle, with impact frames and a shake
--   decay   the cloud thins, the light returns, lightning fades off the ground
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.ThunderPlan)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Pack = require(script.Parent.PackAssembly)

local VFX = {}
local T = Plan.Tuning
local ICE = Color3.fromRGB(235, 252, 255)
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(60, 225, 255)
local AZURE = Color3.fromRGB(16, 120, 225)
local TINT = {deep = AZURE, main = CYAN, hot = ICE}
-- White-hot bolts edged cyan; the storm cloud stays a heavy steel blue.
local BOLT = {deep = CYAN, main = ICE, hot = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}
local STORM = {deep = Color3.fromRGB(128, 132, 146), main = Color3.fromRGB(128, 132, 146), hot = Color3.fromRGB(168, 172, 184)}
local live = 0
local preloaded = false

local SOUND_RUMBLE = CombatAudio.ids.electric_hum
local SOUND_BOOM = CombatAudio.ids.lightning_close
local SOUND_HIT = CombatAudio.ids.electric_shock

function VFX.preload()
	Pack.preload()
	if preloaded then return end
	preloaded = true
	Kit.preload({}, {SOUND_RUMBLE, SOUND_BOOM, SOUND_HIT})
end

function VFX.duration()
	return Plan.duration()
end

function VFX.play(payload, scope)
	if typeof(payload.origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(payload.centre) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(payload.normal) ~= "Vector3"
		or type(payload.points) ~= "table" or type(payload.startedAt) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local total = Plan.duration()
	if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - payload.startedAt >= total or live >= 3 then return false end
	live += 1
	scope:add(function() live -= 1 end)
	VFX.preload()

	local centre = payload.centre
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	local finalAt = Plan.finalAt()
	local folder = scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"))
	folder.Name = "Thunderhead"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	Pack.endWithCaster(scope, payload.caster)
	local function mount(name, cframe, scale, budget)
		return Pack.mount(scope, folder, name, {cframe = cframe, scale = scale, budget = budget, tint = TINT, brightness = 2.5})
	end

	-- The storm ------------------------------------------------------------------
	local cloudAt = CFrame.new(centre + up * T.CloudHeight)
	local cloud = Pack.mount(scope, folder, "StormCloud", {cframe = cloudAt, scale = 0.4, visible = true, tint = STORM, hide = {Wind = true}})
	cloud:centreOn("Soul Cloud")
	cloud:place(cloudAt)
	cloud:fade(0)
	local gloom = mount("Thunder", CFrame.new(centre + up * T.CloudHeight * 0.5), 0.6, 40)
	gloom:only("Clouds"):stream(true)
	local grade = scope:add(Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"))
	grade.Name = "ThunderheadGloom"
	grade.Parent = Lighting
	local light = Kit.light(Kit.host(folder, "Glow", CFrame.new(centre + up * 6)), CYAN, 60)

	local sparks = {}
	for i, point in ipairs(payload.points) do
		sparks[i] = mount("LightningSurge", CFrame.new(point + up), 1.2, 30)
	end
	local rim = mount("LightningSurge", CFrame.new(centre + up), 2.6, 50)
	rim:stream(true)

	local flash = 0
	local function strike(point, scale, grand)
		local frame = CFrame.lookAt(point + up * 1.5, point + up * 10)
		Pack.bolt(scope, folder, point, {tint = BOLT, scale = 5.5 * scale, height = 14 * scale, width = 7 * scale})
		-- A solid column for the instant the bolt connects.
		local column = mount("KiBlast4", CFrame.new(point), 0.75 * scale)
		column:taper(0.55)
		column:stretch(point + up * T.CloudHeight, point)
		column:beamsOn(true)
		scope:delay(0.13, function() column:beamsOn(false) end)
		mount("Impact45", frame, 0.95 * scale):burst(0.8)
		mount("Impact12", frame, 2.6 * scale):burst(1)
		mount("Impact37", frame, 2.2 * scale):burst(1)
		mount("Impact36", frame, 3.2 * scale):burst(1)
		flash = if grand then 1 else 0.7
		Kit.sound(folder, SOUND_BOOM, if grand then 0.8 else 0.5, if grand then 0.8 else 1.1 + scale * 0.1)
		Kit.sound(folder, SOUND_HIT, 0.4, 0.7)
	end

	local timeline = Kit.drive(scope, payload.startedAt, total, function(elapsed)
		local arrive = Kit.smooth(elapsed / (T.Gather * 0.8))
		local leave = 1 - Kit.smooth((elapsed - finalAt - 0.35) / 0.8)
		local presence = arrive * leave
		cloud:fade(presence)
		cloud:place(cloudAt * CFrame.Angles(0, elapsed * 0.25, 0) + up * (8 * (1 - arrive)))
		grade.Brightness = -0.1 * presence + 0.2 * flash
		grade.Contrast = 0.12 * presence
		grade.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(205, 222, 240), presence)
		flash = math.max(flash - 0.09, 0)
		light.Brightness = 2.5 * flash
	end, {folder})

	timeline.at(0, function()
		Kit.sound(folder, SOUND_RUMBLE, 0.5, 0.4)
		ImpactFX.shake(centre, 0.4, T.Gather, 70)
	end)
	for i, point in ipairs(payload.points) do
		timeline.at(math.max(Plan.boltAt(i) - 0.35, 0), function() sparks[i]:stream(true) end)
		timeline.at(Plan.boltAt(i), function()
			sparks[i]:stream(false)
			strike(point, 1, false)
			ImpactFX.shake(point, 1.2, 0.3, 70)
		end)
	end
	timeline.at(finalAt, function()
		strike(centre, 1.6, true)
		ImpactFX.hit(centre + up * 3, {tint = CYAN, pattern = "double", shake = 2.4, shakeDuration = 0.6, punch = 8, radius = 100})
	end)
	timeline.at(finalAt + 0.4, function()
		rim:stream(false)
		gloom:stream(false)
	end)
	return true
end

return VFX

local CombatAudio = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.CombatAudio)
-- Building blocks shared by the ability VFX modules: invisible emitter hosts,
-- emitters built from curated library entries, beams, trails, lights, sounds
-- and a timeline driven by the server clock.
--
-- Every visible effect made here is a ParticleEmitter, Beam or Trail. Parts
-- are anchored, invisible, non-colliding hosts only.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Sounds = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.Sounds)

local Kit = {}

function Kit.ns(a, b)
	return NumberSequence.new(a, b or a)
end

-- curve({time, value, envelope?}, ...)
function Kit.curve(...)
	local points = {}
	for _, p in ipairs({...}) do
		table.insert(points, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1], p[2], p[3] or 0))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(points)
end

-- colors(a, b, ...) spreads the colours evenly from 0 to 1.
function Kit.colors(...)
	local list = {...}
	if #list == 1 then return ColorSequence.new(list[1]) end
	local points = {}
	for i, color in ipairs(list) do
		table.insert(points, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((i - 1) / (#list - 1), color))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(points)
end

function Kit.ramp(t, a, b)
	return math.clamp((t - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
end

function Kit.smooth(t)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

function Kit.flat(direction)
	local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
	return if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then flat.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

function Kit.host(parent, name, cframe, size)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Size, p.Transparency = name, size or Vector3.one * 0.2, 1
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	p.CFrame, p.Parent = cframe, parent
	return p
end

function Kit.attachment(parent, worldCFrame)
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Parent = parent
	if worldCFrame then a.WorldCFrame = worldCFrame end
	return a
end

-- Library fields that are not emitter properties.
local META = {count = true, delay = true}

--[[
	A disabled emitter built from `library[kind]`, with `props` laid over it.
	Layout is set first because flipbook properties depend on it, and table
	iteration is unordered. Rate and Enabled are off unless props turn them on.
]]
function Kit.emitter(library, kind, parent, props)
	local data = library[kind]
	assert(data, "no library entry " .. tostring(kind))
	local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	p.Name = kind
	p.Texture = data.Texture
	if data.FlipbookLayout then p.FlipbookLayout = data.FlipbookLayout end
	for key, value in pairs(data) do
		if not META[key] then p[key] = value end
	end
	p.Enabled, p.Rate, p.TimeScale = false, 0, 1
	if props then
		if props.FlipbookLayout then p.FlipbookLayout = props.FlipbookLayout end
		for key, value in pairs(props) do p[key] = value end
	end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- Emits every {emitter, count} pair.
function Kit.burst(layers, scale)
	for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
		layer[1]:Emit(math.max(1, math.round(layer[2] * (scale or 1))))
	end
end

function Kit.setEnabled(emitters, on)
	for _, e in ipairs(emitters) do
		if e.Enabled ~= on then e.Enabled = on end
	end
end

function Kit.beam(parent, a0, a1, props)
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0, beam.Attachment1 = a0, a1
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do beam[key] = value end
	beam.Parent = parent
	return beam
end

function Kit.trail(parent, a0, a1, props)
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = a0, a1
	trail.LightInfluence = 0
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do trail[key] = value end
	trail.Parent = parent
	return trail
end

-- Beam transparency without rebuilding the sequence every frame.
function Kit.opacity(beam, value)
	local transparency = 1 - math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	if beam.Transparency.Keypoints[1].Value ~= transparency then
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(transparency)
	end
	local on = transparency < 0.99
	if beam.Enabled ~= on then beam.Enabled = on end
end

function Kit.light(parent, color, range)
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness, light.Shadows = color, range, 0, false
	light.Parent = parent
	return light
end

function Kit.sound(parent, id, volume, pitch)
	return CombatAudio.play(id, parent, volume, pitch)
end

function Kit.rayParams(extra)
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local exclude = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then table.insert(exclude, player.Character) end
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(extra or {}) do table.insert(exclude, item) end
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	return p
end

-- Every texture in the given libraries (entry tables or bare ids).
function Kit.textures(...)
	local list = {}
	for _, library in ipairs({...}) do
		for _, data in pairs(library) do
			if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Texture) == "string" then table.insert(list, data.Texture) end
			if type(data) == "string" and string.find(data, "rbxasset") then table.insert(list, data) end
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Fetches textures and sounds in the background. Bare content strings do not
-- reliably fetch images, so each id goes in through a Decal or a Sound.
function Kit.preload(textures, sounds)
	task.spawn(function()
		local assets = {}
		for _, id in ipairs(textures) do
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = id
			table.insert(assets, decal)
		end
		for _, id in ipairs(sounds or {}) do
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.SoundId = id
			table.insert(assets, sound)
		end
		pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(assets) end)
		for _, asset in ipairs(assets) do asset:Destroy() end
	end)
end

-- Studio-only inspection: set workspace attribute AbilityFreeze to a number
-- of seconds and every cast drawn through Kit.drive holds still at that age.
-- The held frame is moved into workspace.AbilityFrozen so it outlives the
-- cast; whoever set the attribute clears that folder.
local function frozenAt(elapsed)
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then return false end
	local at = workspace:GetAttribute("AbilityFreeze")
	return type(at) == "number" and elapsed >= at
end

local function freeze(folders)
	local frame = workspace:FindFirstChild("AbilityFrozen")
	if not frame then
		frame = Instance.new("Folder")
		frame.Name = "AbilityFrozen"
		frame.Parent = workspace
	end
	-- The children move, not the folder: the cast's scope destroys the folder.
	for _, folder in ipairs(folders) do
		for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do child.Parent = frame end
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then d.TimeScale = 0 end
	end
end

--[[
	Runs `update(elapsed)` every frame on the server clock from `startedAt`
	until `total`, then destroys the scope. The returned timeline's
	`at(time, fn)` fires fn once when the cast reaches `time`; a client that
	joins later than `late` (0.3s) after it skips the burst instead of playing
	it out of time. `folders` are what a Studio freeze holds on to.
]]
function Kit.drive(scope, startedAt, total, update, folders)
	local events = {}
	local timeline = {}
	function timeline.at(time, fn, late)
		table.insert(events, {at = time, fn = fn, late = late or 0.3})
	end
	local connection
	local function step()
		if scope:isDead() then return end
		local elapsed = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - startedAt
		if folders and frozenAt(elapsed) then
			connection:Disconnect()
			freeze(folders)
			return
		end
		for _, event in ipairs(events) do
			if not event.done and elapsed >= event.at then
				event.done = true
				if elapsed - event.at <= event.late then event.fn(elapsed - event.at) end
			end
		end
		if update then update(elapsed) end
		if elapsed >= total then scope:destroy() end
	end
	connection = scope:add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step))
	-- First step on the next frame, after the caller has registered events.
	return timeline
end

return Kit

-- Existing PackAssembly/AbilityScope own cloning and lifetime; no cosmetic geometry.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Plan = require(script.Parent.Parent.ReferencePlan)
local Pack = require(script.Parent.PackAssembly)
local Kit = require(script.Parent.AbilityKit)
local ImpactFX = require(script.Parent.ImpactFX)
local Remotes = require(RS.Shared.Net.Remotes)
local Sources = RS:WaitForChild("ReferenceAbilitySources")
local Added = RS:WaitForChild("LegendaryAbilitySources")
local Explosions = RS:WaitForChild("LegendaryExplosionSources")
local VFX = {}
local receivers, pending = {}, {}
local listening, preloaded, live = false, false, 0
local violet = {deep=Color3.fromRGB(24,5,70),main=Color3.fromRGB(123,56,255),hot=Color3.fromRGB(237,222,255)}
local cyan = {deep=Color3.fromRGB(6,68,142),main=Color3.fromRGB(35,206,255),hot=Color3.fromRGB(203,255,239)}
local blue = {deep=Color3.fromRGB(5,6,38),main=Color3.fromRGB(46,109,255),hot=Color3.fromRGB(193,241,255)}
local indigo = {deep=Color3.fromRGB(13,5,65),main=Color3.fromRGB(70,38,255),hot=Color3.fromRGB(151,131,255)}
local mint = {deep=Color3.fromRGB(5,73,86),main=Color3.fromRGB(51,255,177),hot=Color3.fromRGB(218,255,244)}

function VFX.duration() return Plan.duration() end
function VFX.preload()
	if not preloaded then
		preloaded=true
		task.spawn(function() pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({Sources,Added,Explosions}) end) end)
	end
	if listening or not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	listening=true
	Remotes.wait("AbilityImpact").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
		if type(packet)~="table" or not Plan[packet.ability] or type(packet.id)~="string" then return end
		if receivers[packet.id] then receivers[packet.id](packet);return end
		local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local n=0
		for id,events in pairs(pending) do

		-- Align the whole authored host, including every attachment, to this stage.
		if opts.template:IsA("BasePart") then
			effect:alignPart(opts.template.Name,CFrame.identity)

		end
		-- Keep the authored smoke, but reserve screen coverage for the energy silhouette.
		if (name=="RefPortal" and not orb) or name=="LegendWindSwirls" or name=="LegendStylizedWind" then
			for _,e in ipairs(effect.emitters) do
				local c=e.v.Color.Keypoints[1].Value
				if math.max(c.R,c.G,c.B)<.16 then
					local keys={}

					for _,k in ipairs(e.v.Transparency.Keypoints) do table.insert(keys,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(k.Time,1-(1-k.Value)*opacity,k.Envelope*opacity)) end
					e.v.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(keys)
				end
			end
		end
		-- Simultaneous detonations keep their full silhouettes, with less stacked glare.
		if live>=3 then
			for _,e in ipairs(effect.emitters) do
				local keys={}
				for _,k in ipairs(e.v.Transparency.Keypoints) do
					table.insert(keys,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(k.Time,1-(1-k.Value)*.65,k.Envelope*.65))
				end

	local function burst(name,frame,scale,strength,life)

		for _,e in ipairs(effect.emitters) do

		end

				-- Keep the broad glow/ring layers sparse so the centre stays readable.
				for _,e in ipairs(effect.emitters) do

function VFX.play(payload,scope,fireballImpact)
	local starter=payload.ability=="Fireball"
	local T=if starter then StarterPlan.Fireball else Plan[payload.ability]
	if not T or type(payload.id)~="string" or typeof(payload.origin)~="CFrame" or type(payload.startedAt)~="number" then return false end
	local duration=if starter then StarterPlan.duration() else T.duration
	local age=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-payload.startedAt
	if age>duration or live>=8 then return false end
	if payload.target and typeof(payload.target)~="Vector3" then return false end

		local opts={template=Sources and Sources:FindFirstChild(name),cframe=frame,scale=scale,tint=tint,budget=(budget or 150)*density,brightness=2.4}
		for key,value in pairs(extra or {}) do opts[key]=value end
		return Pack.mount(scope,folder,name,opts)
	end
	local function burst(name,frame,scale,strength)
		local effect=make(name,frame,scale,450)

		scope:add(humanoid.Died:Connect(function() scope:destroy() end))
		scope:add(payload.caster.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() scope:destroy() end))
		local tool=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

		local halo=make("RefPortal",frame,if celestial then .34 else .5,45,{locked=true})
		local tail=make(if celestial then "RefKi2" else "RefKi1",frame,if celestial then .085 else .06,45)

		local ribbons={}

				end
			end
			for i,effect in ipairs(wisps) do
				local angle=elapsed*4+i*math.pi

		end

		if not payload.centre then scope:destroy();return false end
		local centre,normal=payload.centre,payload.normal
		local floorFrame=CFrame.new(centre+normal*.25)
		local portalFrame=floorFrame*CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)
		local vortex=payload.ability=="RiftMaelstrom"
		local warning=make("RefImpact36",floorFrame,if vortex then 1.4 else 1.2,20)

		rim:stream(true)

		if vortex then

			for i=1,3 do
				moving[i]=make("RefPortal",portalFrame,1.05+i*.2,95)
			end
		end
		local ended=false
		local function stop()
			ended=true;rim:stream(false);halo:stream(false);halo:beamsOn(false)

		end
		local function strike(packet)

		end
		signal=function(packet)
			if workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-packet.startedAt>.4 then return end
			if packet.event=="strike" then strike(packet)
			elseif packet.event=="pulse" then

			if ended then return end

		end
	end
	receivers[payload.id]=function(packet)
		if scope:isDead() then return end
		if packet.cancelled or packet.event=="cancel" then scope:destroy();return end
		if starter and not packet.event then packet=table.clone(packet);packet.event="hit" end

	if queued then for _,packet in ipairs(queued) do if scope:isDead() then break end;receivers[payload.id](packet) end end
	if scope:isDead() then return false end
	update(age)
	scope:add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() update(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-payload.startedAt) end))
	return true
end

--[[
	BossEffectClient

	Draws the one-shot effects a boss asks for: particle bursts, flashes and
	camera kicks, which are presentation and belong on the client. Signus's
	persistent telegraphs, projectiles, aura and eclipse are rendered by
	SignusVisuals on invisible server carriers. Their positions and combat
	decisions remain authoritative; particle bursts arrive through this remote.

	Listens to the `BossEffect` remote, which BossService ensures at server
	start. The payload names the boss, and the boss's VFX module in
	Shared.Abilities.VFX draws it:

		{
			boss      = "Signus",          -- Shared.Abilities.VFX.<boss>VFX
			kind      = "impact",          -- what to draw; the module decides
			position  = Vector3,
			startedAt = number,            -- workspace:GetServerTimeNow() when sent
			...                            -- anything else the kind needs
		}

	Nothing here decides anything. A bad payload is dropped, a late one is
	drawn where it was asked, and a flood of them is bounded by
	MAX_CONCURRENT: past that, bursts are skipped rather than queued, because
	a burst drawn a second late is a burst drawn in the wrong place.

	Every effect runs inside an AbilityScope that is destroyed when the module
	says it is done, with a backstop a second later, so an effect that errors
	halfway leaves nothing behind.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Remotes = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Net"):WaitForChild("Remotes"))
local AbilityScope = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Abilities"):WaitForChild("AbilityScope"))
local VFXFolder = Shared:WaitForChild("Abilities"):WaitForChild("VFX")

CombatAudio.preload()

require(VFXFolder:WaitForChild("SignusVisuals")).start()

local MAX_CONCURRENT = 28
local DEFAULT_DURATION = 3

local active = 0
local modules = {}

local function moduleFor(boss: string)
	local cached = modules[boss]
	if cached ~= nil then
		return cached or nil
	end

	local moduleScript = VFXFolder:FindFirstChild(boss .. "VFX")
	if not (moduleScript and moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript")) then
		warn(string.format("[BossEffectClient] no VFX module '%sVFX' in Shared.Abilities.VFX", boss))
		modules[boss] = false
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.play) ~= "function" then
		warn(string.format(
			"[BossEffectClient] '%sVFX' did not load as a VFX module (needs a `play` function): %s",
			boss, tostring(result)
		))
		modules[boss] = false
		return nil
	end

	modules[boss] = result
	return result
end

BossEffect.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.boss) ~= "string" or type(payload.kind) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if typeof(payload.position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end

	CombatCues.boss(payload)
	if payload.audioOnly then return end

	if active >= MAX_CONCURRENT then
		return
	end

	local vfx = moduleFor(payload.boss)
	if not vfx then
		return
	end

	local scope = AbilityScope.new()
	active += 1

	local finished = false
	local function finish()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		finished = true
		active -= 1
		scope:destroy()
	end

	local ok, duration = pcall(vfx.play, payload, scope)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[BossEffectClient] %s %s errored: %s", payload.boss, payload.kind, tostring(duration)))
		finish()
		return
	end

	if type(duration) ~= "number" then
		duration = DEFAULT_DURATION
	end

	task.delay(duration + 1, finish)
end)

-- Fireball shares Blighted Fireball's particle body in ReferenceVFX;
-- its original authored explosion and tint remain here.
local MUZZLE=3.5
local Shots={
	Fireball={
		tint={deep=Color3.fromRGB(150,12,3),main=Color3.fromRGB(255,58,8),hot=Color3.fromRGB(255,142,44)},
	},
	WaterBlade={

		-- The arc cuts forward, tipped up and rolled so its face stays to the camera;
		-- lying flat it turns edge-on from behind the caster.
		lie=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(58),0,math.rad(-16))*CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero,Vector3.yAxis,-Vector3.xAxis,Vector3.zAxis),
		glow={"Droplets69",.55,40},tail={"KiBlast2",.09},length=15,
