--[[
	While it lives, the world is tinted. A ColorCorrectionEffect in Lighting,
	made on the server so every client sees the same sky; it never touches the
	clock, which the day and night cycle owns.

	Left in place, neutral, when the fight ends rather than destroyed, so a
	second Eye arriving while the first fades out cannot have its sky deleted
	from under it. A neutral colour correction draws nothing.
]]
local SKY = {
	[1] = { TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 226), Saturation = -0.12, Contrast = 0.04 },
	[2] = { TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 166, 158), Saturation = -0.3, Contrast = 0.14 },
	clear = { TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Saturation = 0, Contrast = 0 },
}

local function skyEffect(): ColorCorrectionEffect
	local effect = Lighting:FindFirstChild(SKY_EFFECT_NAME)
	if not (effect and effect:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")) then
		effect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		effect.Name = SKY_EFFECT_NAME
		effect.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		effect.Parent = Lighting
	end
	return effect
end

local function setSky(level, seconds: number)
	TweenService:Create(skyEffect(), TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), SKY[level]):Play()
end

local function isNight(): boolean
	local clock = Lighting.ClockTime
	return clock < 6 or clock >= 18
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sight
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local sightParams = RaycastParams.new()
sightParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

--[[
	The first block between two points, or nil when the line is clear.

	Only the terrain is tested, and placed blocks ARE terrain - placement goes
	through the same chunks and the same renderer - so a wall somebody built is
	cover exactly as a hillside is.
]]
local function sightBlock(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): RaycastResult?
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("GeneratedTerrain")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end

	sightParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	return workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, sightParams)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Where it is, and where it is looking
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
	Turns a direction toward another, by at most `maxRadians`, about whatever
	axis gets there shortest. The 3D version of the Slime Emperor's turn: an
	eye looks up and down as well as round.
]]
local function turnToward(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, maxRadians: number): Vector3
	if to.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return from
	end
	to = to.Unit

	local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(from:Dot(to), -1, 1))
	if angle <= maxRadians then
		return to
	end

	local axis = from:Cross(to)
	if axis.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
		-- Exactly opposite: any perpendicular will do.
		axis = from:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
		if axis.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
			axis = Vector3.xAxis
		end
	end

	return (CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, maxRadians) * from).Unit
end

--[[
	Keeps a look direction off the vertical. CFrame.lookAt has no sensible
	answer for "straight down", and an eye directly above someone is exactly
	when it would be asked - so it is held a few degrees off.
]]
local function safeLook(look: Vector3): Vector3
	if look.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return Vector3.new(0, -0.5, -1).Unit
	end
	look = look.Unit

	if math.abs(look.Y) <= 0.97 then
		return look
	end

	local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	local y = if look.Y > 0 then 0.97 else -0.97
	return (flat.Unit * math.sqrt(1 - y * y) + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)).Unit
end

-- Poses the model from its position and look, plus its bob and any extra turn.
local function applyPose(entry, extra: CFrame?)
	local position = entry.position + Vector3.new(0, entry.bob or 0, 0)
	local frame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + safeLook(entry.look))
	if extra then
		frame *= extra
	end
	entry.model:PivotTo(frame * (entry.orient or CFrame.identity))
end

-- The front of the eye: where the pupil is, and later the mouth.
local function pupilOf(entry): Vector3
	return entry.position + safeLook(entry.look) * (entry.radius or 3)
end

local function groundUnder(position: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(position.X, EnemyService.groundAt(position.X, position.Z, position.Y), position.Z)
end

-- Eases toward a point with a capped speed: it floats, it does not snap.
local function moveToward(entry, goal: Vector3, dt: number, maxSpeed: number)
	local desired = (goal - entry.position) * Tuning.hover.response
	if desired.Magnitude > maxSpeed then
		desired = desired.Unit * maxSpeed
	end
	entry.velocity = entry.velocity:Lerp(desired, math.clamp(dt * 4, 0, 1))
	entry.position += entry.velocity * dt
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The two forms
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function assetsFolder(): Instance?
	return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(EnemyConfig.AssetsFolder or "EnemyAssets")
end

-- Every visible surface under `root`, with the transparency it was built with.
local function visualParts(root: Instance, skip: Instance?)
	local list = {}
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if skip and (descendant == skip or descendant:IsDescendantOf(skip)) then
			continue
		end
		-- Decal covers Texture too.
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") or descendant:IsA("Decal") then
			table.insert(list, { instance = descendant, transparency = descendant.Transparency })
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function setVisible(list, visible: boolean)
	if not list then
		return
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(list) do
		if item.instance.Parent then
			item.instance.Transparency = if visible then item.transparency else 1
		end
	end
end

local function asModel(template: Instance): Model?
	if template:IsA("Model") then
		return template:Clone()
	elseif template:IsA("BasePart") then
		local model = Instance.new("Model")
		local part = template:Clone()
		part.Parent = model
		model.PrimaryPart = part
		return model
	end
	return nil
end

local function largest(size: Vector3): number
	return math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
end

--[[
	Puts the mouthed form inside the boss, hidden, the same size as the eye and
	centred on it, so revealing it later is a swap of what is visible and
	nothing else.
]]
local function buildMouthForm(entry)
	local folder = assetsFolder()
	local template = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(MOUTH_ASSET)
	if not template then
		warn(string.format(
			"[AllSeeingEye] no %s in ReplicatedStorage.%s; it will keep its eye in phase two.",
			MOUTH_ASSET, tostring(EnemyConfig.AssetsFolder)
		))
		return
	end

	local form = asModel(template)
	if not form then
		warn(string.format("[AllSeeingEye] %s must be a Model or a part.", MOUTH_ASSET))
		return
	end
	form.Name = "MouthForm"

	local eyeBox, eyeSize = entry.model:GetBoundingBox()
	local formSize = form:GetExtentsSize()
	if largest(formSize) > 0.01 then
		form:ScaleTo(form:GetScale() * largest(eyeSize) / largest(formSize))
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(form:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
			descendant.CanQuery = false
		end
	end

	-- Turned to the eye's pivot, plus its own correction if it was built a
	-- different way round from the eye; then moved so the two are centred
	-- on each other whatever either model's pivot is.
	local rotation = entry.def.mouthRotation
	local turn = if typeof(rotation) == "Vector3"
		then CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotation.X), math.rad(rotation.Y), math.rad(rotation.Z))
		else CFrame.identity
	form:PivotTo(entry.model:GetPivot() * turn)
	local formBox = form:GetBoundingBox()
	form:PivotTo(form:GetPivot() + (eyeBox.Position - formBox.Position))

	form.Parent = entry.model

	entry.mouthParts = visualParts(form)
	setVisible(entry.mouthParts, false)
	entry.eyeParts = visualParts(entry.model, form)
end

local function servantsAlive(): number
	return #EnemyService.allOf(SERVANT)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Attack plumbing
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
	Waits, unless it is finished. False if the fight ended during the wait, so a
	caller stops in one line.
]]
local function pause(entry, seconds: number): boolean
	local deadline = os.clock() + seconds
	repeat
		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return false
		end
		task.wait()
	until os.clock() >= deadline
	return not entry.eyeFinished
end

local function phaseOf(entry): number
	return if entry.health / entry.def.health <= Tuning.phase2At then 2 else 1
end

-- A glowing point held at the pupil for as long as `scope` lives.
local function pupilGlow(entry, scope, color: Color3, size: number): Part
	local glow = newPart(Vector3.one * size, color, 0.15)
	glow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	glow.Position = pupilOf(entry)
	glow.Parent = workspace
	scope:add(glow)

	scope:spawn(function()
		while glow.Parent and not entry.eyeFinished do
			glow.Position = pupilOf(entry)
			task.wait()
		end
	end)

	return glow
end

-- Said once per server, so a missing model is reported rather than leaving a
-- fight with no servants and no explanation.
local warnedNoServant = false

local function spawnServant(position: Vector3): Model?
	local model, reason = EnemyService.spawn(SERVANT, position)
	if model then
		flare(position, 2.5, 0.35, Colors.gaze)
	elseif not warnedNoServant then
		warnedNoServant = true
		warn("[AllSeeingEye] could not summon a Demon Eye:", reason)
	end
	return model
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The attacks
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

--[[
	SERVANTS OF THE EYE

	It settles over you, its pupil swells with light, and small eyes are pushed
	out of it one after another and come for you. Straight from the original.
	Capped, so ignoring them is a choice with a ceiling.
]]
local function summonServants(entry, phase: number)
	local S = Tuning.summon
	local scope = entry.scope

	entry.focus = pickTarget(entry) or entry.focus
	entry.motion = "hover"

	local glow = pupilGlow(entry, scope, Colors.gaze, 0.6)
	scope:tween(glow, TweenInfo.new(S.gather, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		Size = Vector3.one * math.max(1.2, entry.radius * 0.7),
	})
	if not pause(entry, S.gather) then
		return
	end

	local alive = servantsAlive()
	for _ = 1, S.count[phase] or 3 do
		if alive >= S.maxAlive then
			break
		end
		if spawnServant(pupilOf(entry) + safeLook(entry.look) * 2) then
			alive += 1
		end
		if not pause(entry, S.gap) then
			return
		end
	end
end

--[[
	Plans the trench a gouging charge will rip: every column under its path
	where the path passes close enough to the ground, frozen now and drawn now,
	before it moves. Sorted by how far along the path each cell is, so the
	ground goes as the eye reaches it rather than all at once.
]]
local function planGouge(entry, from: Vector3, to: Vector3)
	local G = Tuning.gouge
	local line = to - from
	local length = line.Magnitude
	if length < 1 then
		return nil
	end
	local unit = line.Unit

	local columns, seen = {}, {}
	for distance = 0, length, G.sample do
		local point = from + unit * distance
		local ground = EnemyService.groundAt(point.X, point.Z, point.Y)
		if point.Y - ground <= G.skim then
			local key = math.floor(point.X / STUD_SIZE) .. "," .. math.floor(point.Z / STUD_SIZE)
			if not seen[key] then
				seen[key] = true
				table.insert(columns, { x = point.X, z = point.Z, y = ground, depth = G.depth })
			end
		end
	end

	if #columns == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local plan = TerrainManager:PlanExcavation(columns, { maxCells = G.maxCells })
	if #plan == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	-- The trench, drawn on the cells it will take.
	local marks = {}
	for index, cell in ipairs(plan) do
		cell.along = (cell.position - from):Dot(unit)
		local mark = newPart(
			Vector3.new(STUD_SIZE * 0.92, 0.2, STUD_SIZE * 0.92),
			Colors.gaze,
			0.5
		)
		mark.Position = cell.position + Vector3.new(0, STUD_SIZE * 0.5 + 0.12, 0)
		mark.Parent = workspace
		entry.scope:add(mark)
		marks[index] = mark
		cell.mark = mark
	end

	table.sort(plan, function(a, b)
		return a.along < b.along
	end)

	return { plan = plan, from = from, unit = unit, nextIndex = 1 }
end

-- Takes the trench cells the eye has now reached, or all that are left.
local function advanceGouge(entry, gouge, position: Vector3, final: boolean)
	local reached = (position - gouge.from):Dot(gouge.unit)
	local batch = {}

	while gouge.nextIndex <= #gouge.plan do
		local cell = gouge.plan[gouge.nextIndex]
		if not final and cell.along > reached + 2 then
			break
		end
		table.insert(batch, cell)
		if cell.mark then
			cell.mark:Destroy()
		end
		gouge.nextIndex += 1
	end

	if #batch == 0 then
		return
	end

	local removed, samples = TerrainManager:ExecuteExcavation(batch)
	if removed > 0 then
		broadcastDebris(pupilOf(entry), samples, Tuning.gouge.swallow)
	end
end

--[[
	One dash.

	It rears back while it locks on, then goes. A normal dash re-aims at the
	last instant, the way the original does; a gouging one is aimed when the
	trench is drawn and keeps to it, because the mark on the floor is a promise
	and the eye does not break it. Either way it turns slowly mid-dash, so
	stepping sideways is the dodge.
]]
local function dash(entry, target: Player?, ledger, key: string, options): boolean
	local root = livingRoot(target)
	if not root then
		target = nearestPlayer(entry.position)
		root = rootOf(target)
		if not root then
			return false
		end
	end

	entry.motion = "scripted"

	local direction = safeLook(root.Position - entry.position)
	local gouge = nil
	local plannedTravel = 0
	if options.gouge then
		plannedTravel = math.min(
			(root.Position - entry.position).Magnitude + options.overshoot,
			Tuning.charge.maxDistance
		)
		gouge = planGouge(entry, entry.position, entry.position + direction * plannedTravel)
	end

	-- WIND UP: back off, locking on.
	local start = entry.position
	local began = os.clock()
	local last = began
	while os.clock() - began < options.windup do
		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return false
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = math.min(now - last, 0.1)
		last = now

		if not gouge and livingRoot(target) == root then
			direction = safeLook(root.Position - entry.position)
		end
		entry.look = turnToward(entry.look, direction, math.rad(Tuning.charge.lockTurnRate) * dt)

		local alpha = (now - began) / options.windup
		local eased = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
		entry.position = start - direction * options.rearBack * eased
		applyPose(entry)
		task.wait()
	end

	BossAudio.emit(SELF,"dash",pupilOf(entry))
	-- COMMIT. A target who died during the wind-up is not re-aimed at; the
	-- dash goes where it was already locked.
	if not gouge and livingRoot(target) == root then
		direction = safeLook(root.Position - entry.position)
	end
	entry.look = direction

	-- A gouging dash runs the path it drew, from where the rear-back left it.
	local travel = if gouge
		then plannedTravel + options.rearBack
		else math.min((root.Position - entry.position).Magnitude + options.overshoot, Tuning.charge.maxDistance)
	travel = math.clamp(travel, 8, Tuning.charge.maxDistance)

	local reach = (entry.radius or 3) + Tuning.charge.hitPadding
	local moved = 0
	last = os.clock()

	while moved < travel do
		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return false
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = math.min(now - last, 0.1)
		last = now

		if options.steer > 0 and livingRoot(target) == root then
			direction = turnToward(direction, root.Position - entry.position, math.rad(options.steer) * dt)
		end

		local step = options.speed * dt
		entry.position += direction * step
		moved += step
		entry.look = direction
		applyPose(entry)

		for _, player in ipairs(livingPlayers()) do
			local victim = rootOf(player)
			if victim and (victim.Position - entry.position).Magnitude <= reach then
				hitOnce(ledger, key, player, options.damage, options.cap)
			end
		end

		if gouge then
			advanceGouge(entry, gouge, entry.position, false)
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if gouge then
		advanceGouge(entry, gouge, entry.position, true)
	end

	return pause(entry, options.recover)
end

--[[
	CHARGE

	Three dashes in a row, as the original. In phase two they are faster and
	GOUGE: wherever the path skims the floor a trench is drawn first and torn
	out as the eye passes, the ground flying into its mouth. Below a quarter
	health the three are followed by chain dashes, and below a tenth by twice
	as many.
]]
local function charge(entry, phase: number)
	local C = Tuning.charge
	local target = pickTarget(entry) or nearestPlayer(entry.position)
	if not target then
		return
	end

	local ledger = {}
	local normal = {
		windup = C.windup[phase],
		rearBack = C.rearBack,
		speed = C.speed[phase],
		overshoot = C.overshoot,
		steer = C.steer[phase],
		recover = C.recover[phase],
		damage = C.damage[phase],
		cap = C.capPerVolley,
		gouge = phase == 2,
	}

	for index = 1, C.count do
		if not dash(entry, target, ledger, "dash" .. index, normal) then
			return
		end
	end

	if phase < 2 then
		return
	end

	local F = Tuning.frenzy
	local fraction = entry.health / entry.def.health
	local extra = if fraction <= Tuning.frenzyHardAt
		then F.dashes.hard
		elseif fraction <= Tuning.frenzyAt then F.dashes.soft
		else 0
	if extra == 0 then
		return
	end

	entry.bossPhase = ATTACK_NAMES.frenzy
	BossService.update(entry)

	local quick = {
		windup = F.windup,
		rearBack = 2,
		speed = F.speed,
		overshoot = F.overshoot,
		steer = F.steer,
		recover = F.recover,
		damage = F.damage,
		cap = C.capPerVolley,
		gouge = false,
	}

	for index = 1, extra do
		-- A fresh target each time when there is a crowd, so the frenzy goes
		-- through the room rather than down one player.
		local victim = if index % 2 == 0 then (pickTarget(entry) or target) else target
		if not dash(entry, victim, ledger, "frenzy" .. index, quick) then
			return
		end
	end
end

--[[
	Burns away the cover between the eye and whoever it was looking at:
	the natural ground at the point the gaze struck. A PLACED block refuses to
	burn - TerrainManager will not plan it - which is what makes building a
	wall the answer to the gaze rather than a delay.
]]
local function burnCover(entry, hit: RaycastResult)
	local G = Tuning.gaze
	local inside = hit.Position - hit.Normal * (STUD_SIZE * 0.5)

	local plan = TerrainManager:PlanExcavation({
		{ x = inside.X, z = inside.Z, y = inside.Y, depth = G.burnDepth },
	}, { maxCells = G.burnCells })

	flare(hit.Position, 3, 0.4, Colors.ember)

	if #plan > 0 then
		local removed, samples = TerrainManager:ExecuteExcavation(plan)
		if removed > 0 then
			broadcastDebris(pupilOf(entry), samples, 0.6)
		end
	end
end

--[[
	WATCHFUL GAZE

	It stops, and stares. A beam of sight runs from its pupil to one player,
	thickening for a couple of seconds. If the line is still clear when it
	ends, they are hit and two servants are sent straight at them.

	The beam shows the truth every frame: where a block is in the way it ends
	at the block and goes dim. So a player can see whether they are hidden,
	and from where.

	Hidden behind natural ground, the gaze burns a hole in it. Hidden behind a
	block they PLACED, nothing happens to anyone - see burnCover.
]]
local function watchfulGaze(entry, _phase: number)
	local G = Tuning.gaze
	local scope = entry.scope

	local target = pickTarget(entry) or nearestPlayer(entry.position)
	local root = livingRoot(target)
	if not root then
		return
	end

	entry.focus = target
	entry.motion = "hold"
	entry.turnRate = G.turnRate

	local beam = newPart(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 1), Colors.gaze, 0.6)
	beam.Parent = workspace
	scope:add(beam)

	local glow = pupilGlow(entry, scope, Colors.gaze, 0.8)

	local began = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - began < G.lock do
		-- Stops if they die mid-stare, rather than hitting the body and
		-- sending servants to circle it.
		if entry.eyeFinished or not root.Parent or not livingRoot(target) then
			return
		end

		local from = pupilOf(entry)
		local hit = sightBlock(from, root.Position)
		local alpha = (os.clock() - began) / G.lock

		layBeam(beam, from, if hit then hit.Position else root.Position, 0.25 + alpha * 0.9)
		beam.Transparency = if hit then 0.82 else 0.55 - alpha * 0.35
		glow.Size = Vector3.one * (0.8 + alpha * 1.4)

		task.wait()
	end

	BossAudio.emit(SELF,"beam",pupilOf(entry))
	-- THE VERDICT, on the line as it is now.
	local from = pupilOf(entry)
	local hit = sightBlock(from, root.Position)

	if hit then
		layBeam(beam, from, hit.Position, 1.6)
		beam.Transparency = 0.2
		burnCover(entry, hit)
	else
		layBeam(beam, from, root.Position, 1.8)
		beam.Transparency = 0.1
		flare(root.Position, 4, 0.4, Colors.gaze)
		CombatService.applyDamage(target, G.damage, SOURCE)

		-- And its servants are sent: out of nowhere, around the one it saw.
		local alive = servantsAlive()
		for index = 1, G.servants do
			if alive >= Tuning.summon.maxAlive then
				break
			end
			local angle = (index / G.servants) * math.pi * 2 + math.random()
			local spot = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 10, 6, math.sin(angle) * 10)
			if spawnServant(spot) then
				alive += 1
			end
		end
	end

	scope:tween(beam, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { Transparency = 1 })
	pause(entry, 0.4)
end

--[[
	UPROOT

	It looks at the ground around you, and the ground comes up. Three patches,
	ringed for a second before they go; the blocks lift out, leaving holes,
	rise and circle the eye, and are thrown at you one after another - each
	landing spot marked as it is thrown, where you are at that moment.

	The patches are chosen and frozen before they are marked. A patch that has
	nothing natural in it to take simply throws nothing.
]]
local function uproot(entry, _phase: number)
	local U = Tuning.uproot
	local scope = entry.scope

	local target = pickTarget(entry) or nearestPlayer(entry.position)
	local root = livingRoot(target)
	if not root then
		return
	end

	entry.focus = target
	entry.motion = "hold"

	-- THE PATCHES, frozen now: a ring around where you are.
	local centre = root.Position
	local base = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local patches = {}
	for index = 1, U.spots do
		local angle = base + (index - 1) / U.spots * math.pi * 2
		local spot = groundUnder(centre + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * U.ring)

		local columns = {}
		for dx = 0, 1 do
			for dz = 0, 1 do
				table.insert(columns, {
					x = spot.X + (dx - 0.5) * STUD_SIZE,
					z = spot.Z + (dz - 0.5) * STUD_SIZE,
					y = spot.Y,
					depth = 1,
				})
			end
		end

		local plan = TerrainManager:PlanExcavation(columns, { maxCells = 4 })
		if #plan > 0 then
			table.insert(patches, { spot = spot, plan = plan, angle = angle })
			telegraph(spot, STUD_SIZE * 1.2, U.telegraph, Colors.psychic)
		end
	end

	if #patches == 0 then
		return
	end

	local glow = pupilGlow(entry, scope, Colors.psychic, 0.8)
	scope:tween(glow, TweenInfo.new(U.telegraph), { Size = Vector3.one * 2.2 })
	if not pause(entry, U.telegraph) then
		return
	end

	-- OUT OF THE GROUND.
	local rocks = {}
	for _, patch in ipairs(patches) do
		local removed, samples = TerrainManager:ExecuteExcavation(patch.plan)
		if removed > 0 then
			local rock = blockLook(samples[1] and samples[1].block)
			rock.Size = Vector3.one * U.size
			rock.CFrame = CFrame.new(patch.spot - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
			rock.Parent = workspace
			scope:add(rock)

			gore(patch.spot, 3, 6, { rock.Color, Color3.fromRGB(90, 84, 76) })
			table.insert(rocks, { part = rock, angle = patch.angle, from = rock.Position, state = "rise" })
		end
	end

	if #rocks == 0 then
		return
	end

	local ledger = {}
	local orbit = (entry.radius or 3) + U.orbitGap
	local began = os.clock()
	local throwAt = began + U.rise + U.orbit
	for index, rock in ipairs(rocks) do
		rock.throwAt = throwAt + (index - 1) * U.throwGap
	end

	-- One loop drives every rock: rising, circling, flying, landed.
	while true do
		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local spin = (now - began) * 2.2
		local busy = false

		for index, rock in ipairs(rocks) do
			if rock.state == "done" then
				continue
			end
			busy = true

			local circling = entry.position + Vector3.new(
				math.cos(rock.angle + spin) * orbit,
				1.5,
				math.sin(rock.angle + spin) * orbit
			)
			local position

			if rock.state == "rise" then
				local alpha = math.clamp((now - began) / U.rise, 0, 1)
				local eased = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha)
				position = rock.from:Lerp(circling, eased)
				if alpha >= 1 then
					rock.state = "orbit"
				end
			elseif rock.state == "orbit" then
				position = circling
				if now >= rock.throwAt then
					-- Thrown at where you are NOW, and marked there.
					local victim = livingRoot(target) or rootOf((nearestPlayer(entry.position)))
					if victim then
						rock.state = "fly"
						rock.launchedAt = now
						rock.from = circling
						rock.to = groundUnder(victim.Position)
						telegraph(rock.to, U.radius, U.flight, Colors.psychic)
					else
						rock.state = "done"
						rock.part:Destroy()
						continue
					end
				end
			else
				local alpha = math.clamp((now - rock.launchedAt) / U.flight, 0, 1)
				position = rock.from:Lerp(rock.to, alpha) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * U.arc, 0)

				if alpha >= 1 then
					BossAudio.emit(SELF,"rockImpact",rock.to)
					for _, player in ipairs(playersInCircle(rock.to, U.radius)) do
						hitOnce(ledger, "rock" .. index, player, U.damage, U.cap)
					end
					flare(rock.to + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), U.radius, 0.35, Colors.psychic)
					gore(rock.to + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 2, 8, { rock.part.Color, Color3.fromRGB(90, 84, 76) })
					rock.part:Destroy()
					rock.state = "done"
					continue
				end
			end

			rock.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(spin, spin * 0.7, 0)
		end

		if not busy then
			break
		end
		task.wait()
	end
end

-- A drop of blood that falls from the eye to a marked spot and pools there.
local function tear(entry, scope, spot: Vector3, ledger, key: string)
	local T = Tuning.tears

	telegraph(spot, T.radius, T.warn, Colors.bloodBright)

	local drop = newPart(Vector3.new(0.9, 1.4, 0.9), Colors.bloodBright, 0)
	drop.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	drop.Position = pupilOf(entry)
	drop.Parent = workspace
	scope:add(drop)

	scope:spawn(function()
		local from = drop.Position
		local began = os.clock()
		while true do
			if entry.eyeFinished or not drop.Parent then
				return
			end
			local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - began) / T.warn, 0, 1)
			drop.Position = from:Lerp(spot, alpha * alpha)
			if alpha >= 1 then
				break
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		BossAudio.emit(SELF,"tearImpact",spot)
		drop:Destroy()

		for _, player in ipairs(playersInCircle(spot, T.radius)) do
			hitOnce(ledger, key, player, T.damage, T.cap)
		end
		flare(spot + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), T.radius, 0.3, Colors.bloodBright)

		-- The pool. Its own short life, so it outlasts the attack a little and
		-- then goes; it stops hurting the moment the eye is gone.
		local pool = newDisc(spot + Vector3.new(0, 0.28, 0), T.radius * 0.85, Colors.blood, 0.3)
		pool.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		Debris:AddItem(pool, T.pool)

		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, math.floor(T.pool / T.poolInterval) do
				task.wait(T.poolInterval)
				if entry.eyeFinished or not pool.Parent then
					return
				end
				for _, player in ipairs(playersInCircle(spot, T.radius * 0.85)) do
					CombatService.applyDamage(player, T.poolDamage, SOURCE)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end

--[[
	BLOOD TEARS

	It climbs, and weeps. Drops fall one after another, the first straight at
	you and the rest around you, each marked on the ground for as long as it
	takes to fall. Where they land they pool, and the pools burn for a few
	seconds - the floor around you gets worse the longer you stand in one
	place.
]]
local function bloodTears(entry, _phase: number)
	local T = Tuning.tears
	local scope = entry.scope

	local target = pickTarget(entry) or nearestPlayer(entry.position)
	if not target then
		return
	end

	entry.focus = target
	entry.motion = "hover"
	entry.hoverLift = T.lift

	pupilGlow(entry, scope, Colors.bloodBright, 1)
	if not pause(entry, T.settle) then
		return
	end

	local ledger = {}
	for index = 1, T.drops do
		local root = livingRoot(target) or rootOf((nearestPlayer(entry.position)))
		if not root then
			break
		end

		local offset = if index == 1
			then Vector3.zero
			else Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * T.spread, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * T.spread)
		tear(entry, scope, groundUnder(root.Position + offset), ledger, "tear" .. index)

		if not pause(entry, T.gap) then
			return
		end
	end

	-- The last drops land before the attack is over and its scope goes.
	pause(entry, T.warn + 0.1)
end

--[[
	THE EYE TEARS OPEN

	The phase change. It stops dead and spins, faster and faster; halfway
	through, the iris tears off in a spray of gore and the mouth is there
	instead. Servants spill out, the sky goes to blood, and it comes out of
	the spin hungry.

	Nothing here hurts anyone. The player just did something good, and
	answering that with an unavoidable hit teaches people to stop pushing.
]]
local function tearOpen(entry)
	gore(pupilOf(entry), entry.radius * 1.2, 26, { Colors.sclera, Colors.iris, Colors.bloodBright, Colors.blood })
	flare(entry.position, entry.radius * 3.5, 0.7, Colors.bloodBright)

	if entry.mouthParts then
		setVisible(entry.eyeParts, false)
		setVisible(entry.mouthParts, true)
	end

	setSky(2, 2.5)
end

local function transform(entry, _phase: number)
	local X = Tuning.transform
	entry.motion = "scripted"

	local began = os.clock()
	local last = began
	local angle = 0
	local opened = false

	while os.clock() - began < X.spin do
		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = math.min(now - last, 0.1)
		last = now

		-- Up to speed and back down: a spin that starts and stops at full
		-- speed reads as the model glitching rather than as the eye turning.
		local alpha = (now - began) / X.spin
		local rate = (2 * math.pi * X.revolutions / X.spin) * (math.pi / 2) * math.sin(alpha * math.pi)
		angle += rate * dt
		applyPose(entry, CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0))

		if not opened and alpha >= 0.55 then
			opened = true
			tearOpen(entry)
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if not opened then
		tearOpen(entry)
	end
	applyPose(entry)

	local alive = servantsAlive()
	for index = 1, X.servants do
		if alive >= Tuning.summon.maxAlive then
			break
		end
		local angleOut = (index / X.servants) * math.pi * 2
		local spot = entry.position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angleOut), -0.3, math.sin(angleOut)) * (entry.radius + 3)
		if spawnServant(spot) then
			alive += 1
		end
	end

	entry.transformed = true
	entry.cycleIndex = 0
	pause(entry, 0.6)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The fight
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

local ATTACKS = {
	summon = summonServants,
	charge = charge,
	gaze = watchfulGaze,
	uproot = uproot,
	tears = bloodTears,
	transform = transform,
}

-- The next move in this phase's cycle. Summoning is skipped while the
-- servants are at their cap, since it would do nothing.
local function nextInCycle(entry, phase: number): string
	local cycle = CYCLES[phase]

	for _ = 1, #cycle do
		entry.cycleIndex = (entry.cycleIndex or 0) % #cycle + 1
		local pick = cycle[entry.cycleIndex]
		if not (pick == "summon" and servantsAlive() >= Tuning.summon.maxAlive) then
			return pick
		end
	end

	return "charge"
end

--[[
	One attack, start to finish, in its own thread, with everything it makes
	in a scope that goes when it ends - the same arrangement as the Slime
	Emperor's, for the same reasons. The phase change pre-empts the cycle the
	first time it acts below half health.
]]
local function performAttack(entry, phase: number)
	local pick = if phase == 2 and not entry.transformed then "transform" else nextInCycle(entry, phase)

	BossAudio.emit(SELF,pick,pupilOf(entry))
	entry.bossPhase = if pick == "charge" and phase == 2 then ATTACK_NAMES.gouge else ATTACK_NAMES[pick]
	entry.busy = true
	BossService.update(entry)

	local scope = AbilityScope.new()
	entry.scope = scope

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(ATTACKS[pick], entry, phase)

		if entry.scope == scope then
			entry.scope = nil
		end
		scope:destroy()

		if entry.eyeFinished then
			return
		end

		if not ok then
			warn("[AllSeeingEye]", pick, "failed:", err)
		end

		-- Back to watching, whatever the attack left it doing.
		entry.motion = "hover"
		entry.focus = nil
		entry.turnRate = nil
		entry.hoverLift = 0
		entry.velocity = Vector3.zero

		local now = phaseOf(entry)
		local rest = math.random() * (Tuning.restMax[now] - Tuning.restMin[now]) + Tuning.restMin[now]
		entry.nextAttackAt = os.clock() + rest
		entry.busy = false
		entry.bossPhase = nil
		BossService.update(entry)
	end)
end

--[[
	Touching it. Its body, measured - a sphere around its centre - so the
	reach is the eye you can see, whatever size the model is.
]]
local function contactDamage(entry, now: number, phase: number)
	local C = Tuning.contact
	local reach = (entry.radius or 3) * C.reach + 1.5

	for _, player in ipairs(livingPlayers()) do
		local root = rootOf(player)
		if root and now - (entry.contactAt[player] or -math.huge) >= C.interval then
			if (root.Position - entry.position).Magnitude <= reach then
				entry.contactAt[player] = now
				CombatService.applyDamage(player, C.damage[phase], SOURCE)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- It rises out of sight and is gone: at dawn if it came at night, or when
-- there has been nobody near it for a while.
local function leave(entry, why: string)
	entry.leaving = true
	entry.busy = true
	entry.motion = "scripted"

	if why == "dawn" then
		announce("The All Seeing Eye closes as the sun rises...", "info")
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local from = entry.position
		local began = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - began < Tuning.leaveSeconds do
			if entry.eyeFinished then
				return
			end
			local alpha = (os.clock() - began) / Tuning.leaveSeconds
			entry.position = from + Vector3.new(0, Tuning.leaveRise * alpha * alpha, 0)
			applyPose(entry)
			task.wait()
		end
		EnemyService.despawn(entry.model, "departed")
	end)
end

function AllSeeingEye.start(entry)
	entry.eyeFinished = false
	entry.busy = false
	entry.leaving = false
	entry.transformed = false
	entry.scope = nil
	entry.motion = "hover"
	entry.focus = nil
	entry.turnRate = nil
	entry.hoverLift = 0
	entry.hoverOffset = Vector3.zero
	entry.nextSwayAt = 0
	entry.velocity = Vector3.zero
	entry.bob = 0
	entry.bobPhase = 0
	entry.cycleIndex = 0
	entry.pressure = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	entry.contactAt = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	entry.lastSeenAt = os.clock()

	-- Came at night: then dawn sends it away. Summoned by day, it stays.
	entry.nightBorn = isNight()

	-- Its size, read off the model before anything is added to it.
	entry.radius = largest(entry.model:GetExtentsSize()) * 0.5

	-- It arrives from high above wherever it was put, and comes down to you.
	local placed = entry.model:GetPivot().Position
	entry.position = placed + Vector3.new(0, Tuning.arrive.height, 0)
	local first = rootOf((nearestPlayer(placed)))
	entry.look = safeLook(if first then first.Position - entry.position else Vector3.new(0, -0.5, -1))

	buildMouthForm(entry)

	-- A light inside it, so it reads at night - which is when it comes.
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Colors.gaze
	light.Range = math.max(16, entry.radius * 5)
	light.Brightness = 1.4
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = entry.root

	setSky(1, 3)
	announce("You feel an evil presence watching you...", "bad")

	applyPose(entry)
	entry.nextAttackAt = os.clock() + 3
end

function AllSeeingEye.step(entry, dt: number, now: number)
	-- Built in start(), which EnemyService runs inside a pcall. If that threw,
	-- it waits in place rather than erroring once a frame forever.
	if not entry.position then
		return
	end

	local H = Tuning.hover

	entry.bobPhase += dt
	entry.bob = if entry.motion == "scripted"
		then 0
		else math.sin(entry.bobPhase * 2 * math.pi / H.bobPeriod) * H.bobAmplitude

	local phase = phaseOf(entry)
	local target = nearestPlayer(entry.position, Tuning.giveUpRange)
	if target then
		entry.lastSeenAt = now
	end

	if not entry.busy and not entry.leaving then
		if entry.nightBorn and not isNight() then
			leave(entry, "dawn")
			return
		end
		if now - entry.lastSeenAt >= Tuning.giveUpSeconds then
			leave(entry, "alone")
			return
		end
	end

	if entry.motion ~= "scripted" then
		local focus = livingRoot(entry.focus) or rootOf(target)

		if entry.motion == "hover" and focus then
			-- Directly above, drifting a little: never quite still.
			if now >= entry.nextSwayAt then
				entry.nextSwayAt = now + H.swayEvery
				local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				entry.hoverOffset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * (math.random() * H.sway)
			end
			local goal = focus.Position + entry.hoverOffset + Vector3.new(0, H.height + (entry.hoverLift or 0), 0)
			moveToward(entry, goal, dt, H.speed[phase])
		elseif entry.motion == "hold" then
			entry.velocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		-- It always looks at you.
		if focus then
			local rate = entry.turnRate or H.turnRate
			entry.look = safeLook(turnToward(entry.look, focus.Position - entry.position, math.rad(rate) * dt))
		end

		applyPose(entry)
	end

	if not entry.leaving then
		contactDamage(entry, now, phase)
	end

	if entry.busy or entry.leaving or not target then
		return
	end

	if now >= (entry.nextAttackAt or 0) then
		performAttack(entry, phase)
	end
end

function AllSeeingEye.finish(entry, reason: string?)
	entry.eyeFinished = true
	entry.busy = false

	if entry.scope then
		entry.scope:destroy()
		entry.scope = nil
	end

	-- The sky clears, unless another of it is still out there watching.
	-- EnemyService has already forgotten this one, so allOf does not count it.
	if #EnemyService.allOf(SELF) == 0 then
		setSky("clear", 3)
	end

	-- Only a death gets a death; leaving takes nothing with it.
	if reason == "died" and entry.position then
		BossAudio.emit(SELF,"death",entry.position)
		pcall(function()
			gore(entry.position, entry.radius * 1.6, 34, { Colors.blood, Colors.bloodBright, Colors.sclera, Colors.iris })
			flare(entry.position, entry.radius * 6, 0.9, Colors.gaze)
		end)
		announce("The All Seeing Eye has been defeated!", "good")
	end
end

-- Where the fight changes, as health fractions, for the boss bar's markers
-- (BossService sends it): two stages, the mouth opening at half.
AllSeeingEye.phases = { Tuning.phase2At }

return AllSeeingEye

-- Signus's spells. Server owns every aim, hit and displaced terrain cell; the
-- body plays retargeted pack clips (Shared.Enemies.SignusClips) whose Hit
-- markers are the moments damage and terrain land.
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Terrain=require(script.Parent.Parent.TerrainManager)
local Items=require(RS.Shared.UI.ItemModels)
local Moves={}
local CELL=4
--[[
	WORLDREND. Numbers in pairs are { phase one, phase two }.

	The aim follows its target through the charge and locks for the last half
	second of it: that is the dodge. The beam has no end of its own. It runs
	until it meets a block or fades out at its range; natural ground it meets
	is burnt out and flung aside, so it bores on through a hillside, while a
	placed wall stops it dead. In phase two it fires from the air and keeps
	turning after its target, slowly enough to outrun sideways, ploughing a
	trench toward them. The body plays Grimoire Hit 5: its long Swing -> Hit
	is the charge, held at Hit while the beam fires.
]]
local BEAM={
 charge={1.15,.95},lock=.3,fire={2.4,2.85},collapse=.35,
 range={145,180},radius={6,7.5},tick=.25,damage={8,10},cap={40,52},
 track=160,sweep={12,36}, -- cut inward or change direction instead of kiting at long range
 bore={10,24},boreEvery={.32,.24},rend=8,
 standoff=20,backoff=16, -- studs it wants between it and its target, and how fast it backs off
 burn=12, -- its own rubble vaporised per beam
 depth=2, -- cells below where it first met the ground that it will dig to
}
--[[
	UMBRAL MAELSTROM. The warning is fixed where it first appears; the slam's
	Hit marker is the eruption. Phase two: the storm walks. Two aftershocks
	open after the first, each re-aimed at where its target is heading, each
	with a full warning of its own.
]]
local STORM={warn={.9,.75},active={1.8,1.7},strike=.22,radius={17,19},damage={34,40},cap={34,60},
 chain={radius=14,cells=14,gap=.55,lead=.45,damage=30}}
--[[
	ECLIPSE JUDGMENT. The orb leaves the sleeve on Grimoire Hit 1's Hit.
	Phase two: Judgment Cross. A smaller main column, then two pairs of arms
	sixteen studs out, as a plus one cast and a cross the next. The diagonals
	between the arms are the way out.
]]
local JUDGMENT={warn={.85,.72},travel={.38,.3},active={1.75,1.65},strike=.16,radius={16,12},damage={38,44},cap={38,64},
 arm={radius=8,reach=16,stagger=.28,damage=28,cells=8}}
--[[
	CRESCENT VOLLEY. Each blade forms on a sleeve during a Grimoire swing, its
	line shown and locked on the Swing marker, and flies on Hit. Any block
	stops one. Phase two throws fans of three that bend gently after you.
]]
local VOLLEY={throws={3,2},fan={1,3},spread=16,windup={.42,.3},speed={72,80},life=1.5,hitRadius=3.6,
 homing={0,14},damage={12,12},cap={24,36},recover={.45,.35}}
--[[
	BLACK SUN (phase two). It holds a black sun over its head for over two
	seconds while a thirty-stud ring closes on the ground; then it slams it
	down. Everyone in reach who can see the sun's core is burnt: a block
	between you and it - a hillside, a wall you built - is the cover. The ground
	around it is torn up and thrown. Afterwards it sinks, spent, for a long
	melee window.
]]
local SUN={raise=.35,channel=2.1,radius=30,damage=30,cap=30,height=13,ring={9,13},columns=16,cells=18,recover=2.3}
--[[
	TOTALITY, the turn to phase two. It cannot be hurt while it plays. Grimoire
	Heavy is stretched into a long gather; its Hit is the ignition: the air
	darkens to a purple dusk, the eyes burn violet, the aura deepens and the
	eclipse halo rises. The ground
	under it orbits and is flung, as ever.
]]
local TOTALITY={gather=1.7,hold=1.3,radius=18,cells=28}
--[[
	Cells its spells have dropped a block into. Committed rubble is recorded
	as a placement, exactly like a block a player put down, so this is the only
	way to tell the two apart: Worldrend burns through its own rubble, and a
	wall somebody built still stops it.
]]
local rubble={}
local rubbleCount=0
local function cellKey(position)
 return math.floor(position.X/CELL)..":"..math.floor(position.Y/CELL)..":"..math.floor(position.Z/CELL)
end
local function addRubble(position)
 if rubbleCount>6000 then rubble={};rubbleCount=0 end
 local key=cellKey(position)
 if not rubble[key] then rubble[key]=true;rubbleCount+=1 end
end
--[[
	How high the ground was, per 8-stud patch, the first time a Worldrend met
	it this fight. A beam may only dig BEAM.depth cells below that, so later
	beams cannot each go two cells deeper than the last trench. A patch seen
	for the first time takes the highest of its known neighbours, so a beam
	following its own trench downhill does not start a staircase.
]]
local function groundReference(surface,cell)
 local px,pz=math.floor(cell.X/8),math.floor(cell.Z/8)
 local key=px..":"..pz
 if not surface[key] then
  local y=cell.Y
  for dx=-1,1 do for dz=-1,1 do
   local known=surface[(px+dx)..":"..(pz+dz)]
   if known and known>y then y=known end
  end end
  surface[key]=y
 end
 return surface[key]
end
local function columns(centre,radius,depth)
 local result={}
 for x=-radius,radius,4 do for z=-radius,radius,4 do
  if x*x+z*z<=radius*radius then table.insert(result,{x=centre.X+x,z=centre.Z+z,y=centre.Y,depth=depth or 1}) end
 end end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b) return (Vector3.new(a.x,a.y,a.z)-centre).Magnitude<(Vector3.new(b.x,b.y,b.z)-centre).Magnitude end)
 return result
end
-- A ring of columns between two radii, planned at once so the warning shows
-- exactly what will go.
local function ringColumns(ground,centre,inner,outer,count)
 local result={}
 local base=math.random()*math.pi*2
 for i=1,count do
  local angle=base+(i-1)/count*math.pi*2
  local radius=inner+(outer-inner)*((i%3)/2)
  local spot=ground(centre+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,0,math.sin(angle)*radius))
  table.insert(result,{x=spot.X,z=spot.Z,y=spot.Y,depth=1})
 end
 return result
end
local function blockActor(record,parent)
 local template=Items.find(record.block)
 if template and not template:IsA("BasePart") then template=template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true) end
 local p=if template then template:Clone() else Instance.new("Part")
 for _,child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
  if not (child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then child:Destroy() end
 end
 p.Name=record.block;p.Size=Vector3.one*4;p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.CanTouch=false
 p:SetAttribute("SignusTerrainBlock",true);p.CFrame=CFrame.new(record.source.position);p.Parent=parent
 return p
end
-- A travelling block represents exactly one removed cell and is committed at
-- its reserved landing cell. No cosmetic rock clones and no dropped resources.
local function displace(scope,plan,centre,radius,mode)
 local targets={}
 for i,r in ipairs(plan) do
  local angle=math.atan2(r.position.Z-centre.Z,r.position.X-centre.X)+.35
  targets[i]=centre+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))*(radius+8+(i%3)*4)
 end
 local loan=Terrain:BeginBossDisplacement(plan,targets)
 local folder=scope:add(Instance.new("Folder"));folder.Name="SignusMovingTerrain";folder.Parent=workspace
 local actors={};local done=false
 scope:add(function() if not done then Terrain:FinishBossDisplacement(loan,false) end end)
 for i,r in ipairs(loan.records) do actors[i]=blockActor(r,folder) end
 local result={count=#actors}
 function result:update(t)
  if done then return end
  t=math.clamp(t,0,1)
  for i,r in ipairs(loan.records) do
   local from,to=r.source.position,r.target.position
   local point
   if mode=="orbit" then
    local angle=math.atan2(from.Z-centre.Z,from.X-centre.X)+t*math.pi*2
    local orbit=centre+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,10+math.sin(i*2)*3,math.sin(angle)*radius)
    if t<.25 then point=from:Lerp(orbit,t/.25)
    elseif t<.65 then point=orbit
    else point=orbit:Lerp(to,(t-.65)/.35) end
   else point=from:Lerp(to,t)+Vector3.yAxis*math.sin(math.pi*t)*(if mode=="column" then 26+(i%5)*3 else 9+i%4) end
   actors[i].CFrame=CFrame.new(point)*CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t*math.pi)*i*.3,t*math.pi*2,math.sin(t*math.pi)*.8)
  end
 end
 function result:finish()
  if done then return end
  self:update(1);Terrain:FinishBossDisplacement(loan,true);done=true;folder:Destroy()
  -- A block whose landing was taken goes back to its source, so both count.
  for _,r in ipairs(loan.records) do addRubble(r.target.position);addRubble(r.source.position) end
 end
 return result
end
-- Turns a direction toward another by at most `maxRadians`.
local function turn(from,to,maxRadians)
 local angle=math.acos(math.clamp(from:Dot(to),-1,1))
 if angle<=maxRadians then return to end
 local axis=from:Cross(to)
 if axis.Magnitude<1e-4 then return from end
 return (CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit,maxRadians)*from).Unit
end
function Moves.create(ctx)
 local moves={}
 -- Attributes go on before the carrier is parented, so a client never
 -- mounts it once as phase one and again as phase two.
 local function cast(entry,kind,origin,target,duration,radius,extra)
  local p=ctx.carrier(Vector3.one,Color3.new(1,1,1),0,kind)
  p.CFrame=CFrame.new(origin);p:SetAttribute("Target",target);p:SetAttribute("StartedAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
  p:SetAttribute("Duration",duration);p:SetAttribute("Radius",radius)
  for key,value in pairs(extra or {}) do p:SetAttribute(key,value) end
  p.Parent=workspace;entry.scope:add(p)
  return p
 end
 local function run(entry,seconds,update)
  local began=os.clock()
  repeat
   if entry.signusFinished or entry.scope:isDead() then return false end
   update(math.clamp((os.clock()-began)/seconds,0,1));task.wait()
  until os.clock()-began>=seconds
  update(1);return true
 end
 local function predicted(root,seconds)
  local velocity=Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,0,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
  if velocity.Magnitude>25 then velocity=velocity.Unit*25 end
  return ctx.ground(root.Position+velocity*seconds)
 end
 local function target(entry,lead)
  local player=ctx.pickTarget(entry);local root=ctx.root(player)
  if root then entry.focus=player;return predicted(root,lead or 0),root end
 end
 local function hit(entry,point,radius,amount,ledger,key,cap)
  for _,p in ipairs(ctx.playersInCircle(point,radius)) do
   local root=ctx.root(p)
   if root and not ctx.cover(point+Vector3.yAxis*3,root.Position) then ctx.hit(ledger,key,p,amount,cap or amount) end
  end
 end
 local function moved(entry,count)
  entry.model:SetAttribute("SignusLastMovedBlocks",(entry.model:GetAttribute("SignusLastMovedBlocks") or 0)+count)
 end
 -- Phase two casts from the air.
 local function lift(entry)
  if entry.transformed then entry.hem=ctx.airHem end
 end
 -- Waits for spells spawned beside the main one, so the scope outlives them.
 local function settle(entry,pending)
  while pending.count>0 do if not ctx.pause(entry,.05) then return false end end
  return true
 end
 local function spawnSide(entry,pending,delay,fn)
  pending.count+=1
  entry.scope:spawn(function()
   if ctx.pause(entry,delay) then fn() end
   pending.count-=1
  end)
 end

 -- UMBRAL MAELSTROM
 local function maelstrom(entry,phase,centre,radius,cells,ledger,key,damage)
  local M=STORM;local warn,active=M.warn[phase],M.active[phase]
  local plan=Terrain:PlanExcavation(columns(centre,radius,1),{maxCells=cells})
  cast(entry,"SpiralCast",centre,centre,warn+active+.35,radius,{Phase=phase,Warning=warn,StrikeAt=warn+active*M.strike,Active=active})
  if not ctx.pause(entry,warn) then return end -- centre stays fixed after the warning appears
  local blocks=displace(entry.scope,plan,centre,radius,"orbit")
  moved(entry,blocks.count)
  local erupted=false
  if not run(entry,active,function(t)
   blocks:update(t)
   if t>=M.strike and not erupted then
    erupted=true
    hit(entry,centre,radius,damage or M.damage[phase],ledger,key,M.cap[phase])
    ctx.fx("referenceImpact",centre,{style="spiral",radius=radius,phase=phase})
   end
  end) then return end
  blocks:finish()
 end
 function moves.spiral(entry,phase)
  local centre=target(entry,if phase==2 then .4 else .2);if not centre then return end
  local M=STORM;local radius=M.radius[phase]
  entry.motion="hold";lift(entry)
  entry.model:SetAttribute("SignusLastMovedBlocks",0)
  -- AirSlam's Hit is the eruption: its rise is the whole warning.
  local strikeAt=M.warn[phase]+M.active[phase]*M.strike
  local plan=ctx.clipPlan("AirSlam",{})
  ctx.clip(entry,"AirSlam",{windup=math.max(.2,strikeAt-plan.release),speed=.85})
  local ledger={};local pending={count=0}
  if phase==2 then
   -- The storm walks: each aftershock opens where its target is heading.
   for i=1,2 do
    spawnSide(entry,pending,strikeAt+(i-1)*M.chain.gap,function()
     local root=ctx.root(entry.focus)
     if root then maelstrom(entry,phase,predicted(root,M.chain.lead+M.warn[phase]),M.chain.radius,M.chain.cells,ledger,"chain"..i,M.chain.damage) end
    end)
   end
  end
  maelstrom(entry,phase,centre,radius,28,ledger,"spiral")
  if not settle(entry,pending) then return end
  ctx.pause(entry,.2)
 end

 -- ECLIPSE JUDGMENT
 local function judgment(entry,phase,origin,centre,radius,cells,ledger,key,damage)
  local J=JUDGMENT;local warn,travel,active=J.warn[phase],J.travel[phase],J.active[phase]
  local plan=Terrain:PlanExcavation(columns(centre,radius,2),{maxCells=cells})
  cast(entry,"LanceCast",origin,centre,warn+travel+active+.4,radius,{Phase=phase,Warning=warn,Travel=travel,StrikeAt=warn+travel+active*J.strike,Active=active})
  if not ctx.pause(entry,warn+travel) then return end
  local blocks=displace(entry.scope,plan,centre,radius,"column")
  moved(entry,blocks.count)
  local struck=false
  if not run(entry,active,function(t)
   blocks:update(t)
   if t>=J.strike and not struck then
    struck=true
    hit(entry,centre,radius,damage,ledger,key,J.cap[phase])
    ctx.fx("referenceImpact",centre,{style="lance",radius=radius,phase=phase})
   end
  end) then return end
  blocks:finish()
 end
 function moves.lance(entry,phase)
  local centre=target(entry,if phase==2 then .25 else .2);if not centre then return end
  local J=JUDGMENT
  entry.motion="hold";lift(entry)
  entry.model:SetAttribute("SignusLastMovedBlocks",0)
  -- The orb leaves on Hit 1's Hit, which is where its warning ends.
  local plan=ctx.clipPlan("Light1",{})
  ctx.clip(entry,"Light1",{windup=math.max(.25,J.warn[phase]-plan.release)})
  local ledger={};local pending={count=0}
  if phase==2 then
   -- Judgment Cross: a plus one cast, a cross the next.
   entry.crossTurn=not entry.crossTurn
   local toward=ctx.flat(centre-entry.position)
   local side=Vector3.new(-toward.Z,0,toward.X)
   if entry.crossTurn then toward,side=(toward+side).Unit,(side-toward).Unit end
   local arms={{toward,-toward},{side,-side}}
   for i,pair in ipairs(arms) do
    for _,dir in ipairs(pair) do
     spawnSide(entry,pending,J.warn[phase]*.5+(i-1)*J.arm.stagger,function()
      local spot=ctx.ground(centre+dir*J.arm.reach)
      judgment(entry,phase,ctx.hand(entry),spot,J.arm.radius,J.arm.cells,ledger,"arm"..i,J.arm.damage)
     end)
    end
   end
  end
  judgment(entry,phase,ctx.hand(entry),centre,J.radius[phase],32,ledger,"lance",J.damage[phase])
  if not settle(entry,pending) then return end
  ctx.pause(entry,.25)
 end

 -- WORLDREND
 function moves.beam(entry,phase)
  local _,root=target(entry);if not root then return end
  local B=BEAM
  local charge,fire=B.charge[phase],B.fire[phase]
  local range=B.range[phase]
  entry.motion="aim";lift(entry);entry.model:SetAttribute("SignusLastMovedBlocks",0)
  -- Swing -> Hit of Grimoire Hit 5 is the charge; it holds at Hit while firing.
  local plan=ctx.clipPlan("Light5",{})
  ctx.clip(entry,"Light5",{windup=plan.windup,speed=(plan.hit-plan.swing)/math.max(charge-plan.windup,.2),hold=fire+5})
  local function aimPoint()
   local r=ctx.root(entry.focus);return r and r.Position+Vector3.new(0,.5,0)
  end
  local origin=ctx.hand(entry)
  ctx.fx("beamCharge",origin,{audioOnly=true,phase=phase})
  local direction=((aimPoint() or origin+ctx.flat(entry.look)*20)-origin).Unit
  local carrier=cast(entry,"RiftBeam",origin,origin+direction*range,charge+fire+B.collapse,B.radius[phase],{Charge=charge,Phase=phase,Hit=false,Normal=Vector3.yAxis})
  local ledger={};local groups={};local rend={}
  local tick=-1;local fired=false;local bored,burnt=0,0;local lastBore=-math.huge
  entry.beamGround=entry.beamGround or {}
  local surface=entry.beamGround -- see groundReference
  local lastEnd
  local last=os.clock()
  local function carry(age)
   for _,g in ipairs(groups) do
    if not g.done then
     local a=math.clamp((age-g.at)/1.1,0,1);g.moved:update(a)
     if a>=1 then g.moved:finish();g.done=true end
    end
   end
  end
  local total=charge+fire
  if not run(entry,total,function(t)
   local now=os.clock();local dt=math.min(now-last,.1);last=now
   local age=t*total
   local want=aimPoint()
   -- Too close to fire across at them: it drifts back while it charges.
   if want and age<charge then
    local away=Vector3.new(entry.position.X-want.X,0,entry.position.Z-want.Z)
    if away.Magnitude<B.standoff then
     entry.position+=(if away.Magnitude>.5 then away.Unit else -ctx.flat(entry.look))*B.backoff*dt
    end
   end
   origin=ctx.hand(entry);carrier.CFrame=CFrame.new(origin)
   if want and (want-origin).Magnitude>1 then
    local to=(want-origin).Unit
    if age<charge-B.lock then direction=turn(direction,to,math.rad(B.track)*dt)
    elseif age>=charge and B.sweep[phase]>0 then direction=turn(direction,to,math.rad(B.sweep[phase])*dt) end
   end
   entry.look=ctx.flat(direction)
   -- The first block on the line, if any: that is where it ends.
   local block=ctx.cover(origin,origin+direction*range)
   local finish=if block then block.Position else origin+direction*range
   if not lastEnd or (finish-lastEnd).Magnitude>.15 then carrier:SetAttribute("Target",finish);lastEnd=finish end
   carrier:SetAttribute("Hit",block~=nil)
   if block then carrier:SetAttribute("Normal",block.Normal) end
   if age>=charge and not fired then
    fired=true
    ctx.fx("beamFire",origin,{direction=direction,phase=phase})
    -- Ground close under the beam's line tears up, from the hands outward.
    local delta=finish-origin
    for d=8,delta.Magnitude,7 do
     if #rend>=B.rend then break end
     local point=origin+direction*d;local ground=ctx.ground(point)
     if point.Y-ground.Y<7 then table.insert(rend,{at=age+d/delta.Magnitude*.6,column={x=ground.X,z=ground.Z,y=ground.Y,depth=1},point=ground}) end
    end
   end
   if fired then
    for _,r in ipairs(rend) do
     if not r.taken and age>=r.at then
      r.taken=true
      local plan=Terrain:PlanExcavation({r.column},{maxCells=1})
      if #plan>0 then local m=displace(entry.scope,plan,r.point,5,"throw");moved(entry,m.count);table.insert(groups,{moved=m,at=age}) end
     end
    end
    -- What it meets burns, so the beam bores on: natural ground is torn out
    -- and flung aside, and its own rubble is vaporised. It ploughs rather
    -- than drills: never deeper than a couple of cells below the ground it
    -- first met there (groundReference).
    if block and age-lastBore>=B.boreEvery[phase] then
     lastBore=age
     local cell=block.Position-block.Normal*(CELL*.5)
     if cell.Y>=groundReference(surface,cell)-B.depth*CELL-.1 then
      if rubble[cellKey(cell)] then
       local plan=Terrain:PlanExcavation({{x=cell.X,z=cell.Z,y=cell.Y,depth=1}},{maxCells=1,naturalOnly=false})
       local key=plan[1] and cellKey(plan[1].position)
       if key and rubble[key] and burnt<B.burn then
        rubble[key]=nil
        burnt+=Terrain:ExecuteExcavation(plan,{naturalOnly=false})
       end
      elseif bored<B.bore[phase] then
       local cols={{x=cell.X,z=cell.Z,y=cell.Y,depth=2}}
       if phase==2 then
        local side=direction:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        if side.Magnitude>.1 then
         side=side.Unit*CELL
         table.insert(cols,{x=cell.X+side.X,z=cell.Z+side.Z,y=cell.Y,depth=1})
         table.insert(cols,{x=cell.X-side.X,z=cell.Z-side.Z,y=cell.Y,depth=1})
        end
       end
       local plan=Terrain:PlanExcavation(cols,{maxCells=math.min(4,B.bore[phase]-bored)})
       if #plan>0 then
        local m=displace(entry.scope,plan,block.Position,4,"throw")
        bored+=m.count;moved(entry,m.count);table.insert(groups,{moved=m,at=age})
       end
      end
     end
     ctx.fx("beamImpact",block.Position,{normal=block.Normal,phase=phase})
    end
    local nowTick=math.floor((age-charge)/B.tick)
    if nowTick~=tick then
     tick=nowTick
     local delta=finish-origin
     for _,p in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
      local pr=ctx.root(p)
      if pr then
       local f=math.clamp((pr.Position-origin):Dot(delta)/math.max(delta:Dot(delta),.01),0,1)
       local near=(pr.Position-origin:Lerp(finish,f)).Magnitude<B.radius[phase]
       -- Past the end of a blocked beam only the open side of the block burns.
       if near and block and f>=.98 and ctx.cover(finish+block.Normal*1.5,pr.Position) then near=false end
       if near then ctx.hit(ledger,"beam"..tick,p,B.damage[phase],B.cap[phase]) end
      end
     end
    end
   end
   carry(age)
  end) then return end
  -- The beam is spent: the arm comes down through the rest of the clip.
  ctx.clip(entry,"Light5",{from=plan.hit})
  ctx.stance(entry,"spent")
  -- The collapse, and whatever is still in the air coming down.
  if not run(entry,1.1,function(t) carry(total+t*1.1) end) then return end
  for _,g in ipairs(groups) do if not g.done then g.moved:finish() end end
  ctx.pause(entry,.15)
 end

 -- CRESCENT VOLLEY
 function moves.volley(entry,phase)
  local _,root=target(entry);if not root then return end
  local V=VOLLEY
  entry.motion="hold";lift(entry)
  local ledger={};local pending={count=0}
  local function fly(blade,direction,index)
   local position=blade.Position
   local homing=math.rad(V.homing[phase])
   blade:SetAttribute("Stage","Fly");blade:SetAttribute("FlyAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
   local launched,last=os.clock(),os.clock()
   while os.clock()-launched<V.life do
    if entry.signusFinished or entry.scope:isDead() then return end
    local now=os.clock();local dt=math.min(now-last,.1);last=now
    local victim=ctx.root(entry.focus)
    if homing>0 and victim then direction=turn(direction,(victim.Position-position).Unit,homing*dt) end
    local nextPosition=position+direction*V.speed[phase]*dt
    local block=ctx.cover(position,nextPosition)
    if block then ctx.fx("crescentBreak",block.Position,{normal=block.Normal,phase=phase});break end
    local struck=false
    for _,p in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
     local pr=ctx.root(p)
     if pr and (pr.Position-nextPosition).Magnitude<=V.hitRadius then
      ctx.hit(ledger,"blade"..index,p,V.damage[phase],V.cap[phase])
      ctx.fx("crescentBreak",pr.Position,{phase=phase,struck=true})
      struck=true
     end
    end
    if struck then break end
    position=nextPosition
    blade.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction)
    task.wait()
   end
   blade:Destroy()
  end
  for throw=1,V.throws[phase] do
   if entry.signusFinished or entry.scope:isDead() then return end
   local name=if throw%2==1 then "Light2" else "Light4"
   local plan=ctx.clipPlan(name,{windup=V.windup[phase]})
   local marks=ctx.clip(entry,name,{windup=V.windup[phase]})
   -- Blades form on the throwing sleeve; their line shows until Swing locks it.
   local blades={}
   local count=V.fan[phase]
   for i=1,count do
    local blade=ctx.carrier(Vector3.one,Color3.new(1,1,1),0,"Volley")
    blade:SetAttribute("Phase",phase);blade:SetAttribute("Stage","Form")
    blade:SetAttribute("StartedAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow());blade:SetAttribute("Charge",marks.hit)
    blade.CFrame=CFrame.new(ctx.hand(entry));blade.Parent=workspace;entry.scope:add(blade)
    blades[i]={part=blade,offset=(i-(count+1)/2)*math.rad(V.spread)}
   end
   local aim
   local began=os.clock()
   while os.clock()-began<marks.hit do
    if entry.signusFinished or entry.scope:isDead() then return end
    local r=ctx.root(entry.focus)
    local origin=ctx.hand(entry)
    if r and (os.clock()-began<marks.swing or not aim) then aim=(r.Position+Vector3.yAxis*.5-origin).Unit end
    entry.look=ctx.flat(aim or entry.look)
    ctx.applyPose(entry)
    for _,b in ipairs(blades) do
     local dir=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,b.offset)*(aim or Vector3.zAxis)
